You will be making TikTok videos using Capcut or the video editing software of your choice.  The editing process is fairly simple and straightforward.  Anyone who is proficient in video editing should have no problem with the basic tasks such as:

Cutting dead space in talking head videos

Adding overlay images on screen in the videos

Minor effects such as dynamic zoom, cropping, etc.

Producing b-roll content from voiceover and footage provided, having the ability to digest what is being said and pair up the audio with corresponding footage

Basic talking head - here you are mostly editing dead space and piecing clips together, adding minor effects like crop and zoom to make the frames look more dynamic and seamless.

Can take payments through Wise / Paypal

PH or similar time zone

title: Local SEO & Google Ads Specialist - Australian Hot Water
description:
Yellow Plumbing is seeking a Philippines-based Local SEO & Google Ads specialist to grow Hot Water in a Jiffy, an Australian hot-water repair, replacement and installation service across South-East Melbourne, Bayside and the Mornington Peninsula. We need more qualified enquiries and booked jobs, not vanity traffic.



This is a PAID, FIXED-SCOPE DIAGNOSTIC: up to 8 hours in week one at an indicative AUD $30-$40/hour, with a first-diagnostic maximum of AUD $320. We agree exact pay and deliverables in writing before work begins. This does not promise ongoing weekly hours. No live Google Ads campaigns, media spend, subscriptions, website changes or retainer without separate owner approval.



Assess the public HWIJ website; after controlled access is granted, check any existing Search Console, GA4, Google Business Profile and Google Ads baselines. Identify missing or unreliable tracking. Map local high-intent searches for urgent repair, replacement and suitable heat-pump upgrades. Audit indexing, titles, internal linking, mobile lead paths and useful service content. Propose a tightly scoped Google Search campaign with local targeting, draft ads, search terms and negative keywords. Keep all campaigns PAUSED. Explain how calls and messages become qualified leads, booked jobs and completed installations, and report organic SEO costs separately from paid-ad costs. Flag any claims about same-day service or Victorian rebates for owner verification.



First-diagnostic deliverables: a short baseline/access checklist; prioritised issue list with evidence; local SEO action plan; draft Search campaign structure with sample ads and negative keywords; measurement plan; and a capped proposal for any follow-on work. This is a first-pass diagnostic, not full technical implementation.



You must show hands-on Australian local-service experience, preferably plumbing, HVAC or electrical, and competence in Google Search Ads, Search Console, GA4, Business Profile and call/lead tracking. Explain actual qualified leads or booked-job results from your own work. No guaranteed rankings, fake reviews, mass-produced location pages or link schemes. Yellow Plumbing owns the accounts and billing; any access uses named, limited permissions, not shared passwords.



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with: (1) two concise, verifiable local-service examples, your specific contribution, timeframe, qualified-lead or booking outcomes and a reference, with confidential information redacted; (2) proposed AUD hourly rate or fixed fee, hours, turnaround and any tool costs; (3) a maximum 200-word first look at the public Hot Water in a Jiffy homepage and heat-pump page: one SEO priority, one Search campaign test, and how you would measure booked installations; (4) Philippines location, Melbourne-hours overlap and earliest start.



No full unpaid audit is required. Up to two shortlisted candidates may each be offered a separately agreed paid 1.5-hour exercise (up to AUD $60 each at AUD $40/hour) on public or de-identified information. Only one selected finalist would then complete the first diagnostic. No recruitment fee is charged to applicants.

Australian professional services principal (CFO advisory and a migration agency; firm names disclosed to shortlisted candidates) looking for one person to work directly with me, every day, to build and operate AI across my businesses and my personal workflow.



This is not a project role with a fixed scope. It is a daily working partnership. We will pair for one to two hours most mornings (UTC+8 — Philippines time) and you will carry the work forward during the day. You will build agent teams in Claude Code and Grok, set up the automations around them, develop new AI-based products with me, and — critically — teach me as we go so that I can extend and run everything myself.



I am a CPA who uses Claude Code daily. I know what I want built. I need someone who can build it faster than I can, explain it clearly, and challenge my thinking.

Agent teams for my CFO advisory firm — client bookkeeping review, month-end packs, workpapers, client correspondence.



Agent teams for my migration agency — enquiry handling, document checklists, case preparation and client follow-up.



A personal operating system — calendar,
, task and knowledge management, so my day runs through AI rather than around it.



New products — turning the internal systems above into packaged offerings we can take to market.



Ongoing: documenting everything so the business is never dependent on one person.



**Requirements**



Hands-on with Claude Code (subagents, CLAUDE.md, skill files, MCP) and at least one other frontier model platform (Grok, OpenAI or Gemini). You can show working systems you have built.



Python or TypeScript to a working standard; Git daily; comfortable with APIs, OAuth and webhooks (Xero and Microsoft 365 a strong plus).



A genuine teacher. You can explain a technical decision to a smart non-engineer, live, without jargon — and you enjoy it.



Strong product sense. You will be expected to push back, suggest better approaches and bring ideas, not just take instructions.



Excellent spoken and written English; comfortable on a daily video or voice call.



Available Mon–Fri during UTC+8 business hours; reliable internet and backup power.



**Nice to Have**



n8n, Make or Zapier; Supabase/Postgres; Microsoft Graph API. Any exposure to accounting, bookkeeping or immigration processes. Open-model experience for cost-sensitive workloads.

Daily pairing session, then independent build time. Weekly written goals and a Friday demo. Everything in Git with a README. Secrets in a vault, never in chat. All IP assigned to the firm under a contractor agreement and NDA. Shortlisted candidates complete a paid four-hour test build; the successful candidate starts on a paid 30-day trial.

• Ask how the business handles missed calls, after hours inquiries, spam calls, and appointment booking. Explain the approved AI receptionist offer accurately.

• Check the business website status. If it has no website or the owner describes a specific website problem, ask permission to discuss that need; offer a relevant website conversation without dropping a live receptionist opportunity.

• Book one meeting with the founder for the service or services the owner actually wants. Confirm name, business, phone,
, date and time, stated pain point, and service interest.

• Log each attempt, outcome, objection, next action, website status, and follow up in Zoho. Check duplicates and honor removal requests.

• Send approved confirmations, complete callbacks, flag high intent prospects, and submit the daily scorecard.

Three hour daily workflow

• First 10 minutes: review assigned leads, due follow ups, script, phone, CRM, and calendar.

• Next 130 minutes: focused calls and immediate CRM updates; ask about website need only when supported by the conversation or verified website status.

• Next 30 minutes: callbacks, meeting confirmations, and incomplete qualification notes.

• Final 10 minutes: hand off booked meetings and submit the scorecard.

Starting performance measures

Review attempts, decision makers reached, qualified meetings booked and attended, follow ups completed, accurate service tags, duplicate rate, and call quality. For an initial three hour shift, use 60 to 90 call attempts as a planning range when clean leads and a working dialer are supplied; calibrate after two weeks of actual results. Never count an unqualified calendar slot as a booking. Review two recordings per worker weekly where recording and disclosure are permitted.

Qualifications and equipment

• Clear spoken and written English; experience in outbound calling, appointment setting, sales, or customer service.

• Good discovery questions, natural delivery, accurate notes, and coachability. Familiarity with Zoho, a dialer, and Google Calendar is helpful.

• Reliable computer, stable internet, quality headset, quiet workspace, and backup internet or power plan when possible.

How to apply

• Subject line: MEDINA SETTER followed by your first name.

• Briefly describe your B2B calling and appointment setting experience.

• Attach a 60 to 90 second voice sample: introduce an AI receptionist and naturally bring up a website only after a plausible website need is revealed.

• Answer the six questions below in order. Include a recent internet speed screenshot, requested pay for 15 hours weekly, and confirmation of the posted shift.

Application questions

• What questions would you ask to learn whether an owner is missing calls or bookings?

• If the business has no website, how would you introduce that offer while preserving interest in the receptionist?

• What would you say if the owner replies, “My staff already answers the phone”?

• Which details must be confirmed before a meeting is booked, and how would you record interest in both services?

• Which dialers, CRMs, and calendars have you used? Give one example of improvement after call coaching.

• Can you work the exact shift Monday through Friday for at least 90 days?

title: YouTube Video Editor for Personal Brand Channel
description:
I’m looking for a reliable, creative YouTube Video Editor to help me build and grow a personal-brand YouTube channel. I am looking for an editor to join as soon as Sunday Oct 4th, 2026.



My content focuses on helping women entrepreneurs with ADHD turn scattered tasks, ideas, and projects into simple systems so they know what to do next and actually finish what they start.



Topics may include:



- ADHD and entrepreneurship

- Productivity and organization

- Business systems and workflows

- AI and automation

- Delegation

- Overwhelm and task management

- Building a business when your brain has 47 tabs open



I will primarily be creating talking-head, educational, and story-based YouTube videos.



What You'll Be Doing



You will take my raw footage and turn it into polished, engaging YouTube videos.



This may include:



- Editing long-form YouTube videos

- Removing mistakes, pauses, filler, and unnecessary sections

- Tightening pacing to keep viewers engaged

- Adding B-roll where appropriate

- Adding text, graphics, screenshots, zooms, and visual emphasis

- Adding music and sound effects when appropriate

- Adding captions or emphasized keywords

- Creating pattern interrupts so the video doesn't feel like one long talking head

- Color correction and basic audio cleanup

- Following my branding and editing style

- Exporting finished videos in the correct YouTube format

- Organizing project files and completed videos



Depending on your skill set, there may also be opportunities to:



- Turn long-form videos into YouTube Shorts/Reels

- Help identify strong clips from each video

- Suggest edits that improve audience retention

- Help develop a consistent visual editing style for the channel



The Style I'm Looking For



I DON'T want videos that feel overly corporate, sterile, or like someone added an animation every three seconds just because they could.



I'm building a personality-driven educational channel. I like creatives that incorporate playfulness. 



The editing should feel:



Clean + conversational + energetic + smart + modern



Think editing that supports what I'm saying rather than distracting from it.



I want viewers to feel like they're sitting down with a smart friend who understands their brain and is helping them figure out what to do next.



Who I'm Looking For



You may be a great fit if you:



- Have experience editing YouTube content

- Understand pacing and viewer retention

- Know how to edit talking-head educational content

- Can tell the difference between an important pause and dead space

- Have strong attention to detail

- Can follow editing guidelines while also using good judgment

- Communicate clearly

- Meet deadlines consistently

- Are comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions

- Want a long-term working relationship rather than just completing one video



Experience editing content in the business, productivity, ADHD, education, coaching, or personal-brand space is a plus, but not required.



Important



I'm not looking for someone who simply asks "Where should I cut the video?"



I'm looking for an editor who can watch the content, understand the point I'm making, and make editing decisions that help tell the story and keep the viewer interested.



You don't have to be a YouTube strategist, but you should understand that YouTube editing is different from simply making a video look pretty.



Retention matters.



Compensation



Starting rate: $60 USD per completed 10–15 minute YouTube video. Hours can vary from 5 to 10 hours a week. 



This is a per-video role rather than an hourly position.



There is room to increase the rate based on the quality of your work, consistency, turnaround time, and our long-term working relationship.



Additional compensation may be available for Shorts/Reels or other editing projects outside the standard long-form video.



To Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. At least 3 examples of YouTube videos you've edited, preferably talking-head or educational content.

3. What editing software you use.

4. Your typical turnaround time for a 10–15 minute YouTube video.

5. Your rate per video or hourly rate.

6. Whether you also edit Shorts/Reels.

7. A brief explanation of what you believe makes a talking-head YouTube video engaging.



And please start your application with the words "47 TABS"



This lets me know you actually read the job description.



Potential for Long-Term Work



I'm looking to build this channel consistently, so if we work well together, this can become an ongoing role with regular videos rather than a one-time project.

title: Cold Caller for U.S. Towing Companies | $3/hr | Own Power Dialer + SMS Required
description:
Summary

We are looking for a reliable cold caller to contact towing companies in the U.S. and book qualified meetings for our Google Ads service.



This is a $3/hour position. Please do not apply if you are looking for a higher hourly rate.



You must have your own power dialer that can make a high volume of U.S. calls. We are looking for someone who can make approximately 200 to 300 call attempts within 2 to 3 hours, not someone using a basic dialer to manually call a small number of businesses.



Your power dialer must also support:



- U.S. calling

- SMS messaging

- Call recording

- Call activity and basic reporting



Please tell us which power dialer or calling platform you currently use when applying.



The work must start at 12:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.



PAID TRIAL



We will test multiple candidates, and we can select the best performer for ongoing work.



Round 1: Day 1



- 2 hours of paid calling

- Call U.S. towing businesses using our script

- Any meeting you book during the trial must be scheduled within 24 hours so we can evaluate your results quickly

- Follow up with every booked meeting by SMS and phone before the meeting

- We will evaluate your calling performance, communication, attention to detail, ability to follow the process, and results



Round 2: Day 2



Stronger candidates from Round 1 can continue for another 3 hours.



- Continue calling U.S. towing businesses

- Any meeting you book during the trial must be scheduled within 24 hours

- Send SMS reminders and call every prospect before their meeting

- We will continue evaluating actual conversations, meetings booked, meeting quality, show-up rate, and other results



After the two rounds, we will select one candidate for ongoing work.



ONGOING WORK



The selected candidate will work:



- 4 hours per day

- Monday through Friday

- Starting at 12:00 PM Eastern Time

$3/hour

- Cold calling U.S. towing companies

- Booking qualified meetings with business owners or decision makers

- Sending SMS reminders for every booked meeting

- Calling prospects before every booked meeting to remind them

- Following up with no-shows when appropriate



There will also be a $10 bonus for every qualified meeting that actually shows up.



A booked meeting by itself does not qualify for the bonus. The prospect must actually attend the meeting and be a relevant potential client.



MEETING FOLLOW-UP



Getting the meeting booked is only one part of the job.



For every single booked meeting, you will:



- Send the prospect an SMS with the meeting link while speaking with them

- Confirm that they received the SMS

- Send an SMS reminder before the meeting

- Call the prospect shortly before the meeting to remind them

- Follow up with no-shows when appropriate



The goal is to maximize the number of qualified prospects who actually attend the meeting.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



We will provide:



- A calling script

- Information about our business and what prospects should know about our service

- A list of U.S. locations, cities, and other location information to help with lead research

- Instructions on where and how to find towing business leads and how to organize them for calling



During the paid trial period only, we may provide the business list so you can focus on the calling test. For ongoing work, you will be responsible for finding and organizing the businesses yourself.



Finding and organizing the businesses should generally take around 15 to 30 minutes per day.



REQUIREMENTS



- Clear spoken English

- Previous cold calling or appointment-setting experience

- Experience calling businesses in the U.S.

- Your own power dialer platform

- Power dialer with U.S. calling and SMS capability

- Call recording capability

- Ability to make approximately 200 to 300 call attempts within 2 to 3 hours

- Reliable internet connection

- Availability to start work at 12:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday

- Ability to sound natural and not robotic

- Good attention to detail



Please apply only if you meet the requirements above and start the application with the word honest, so I know you went through the job post.. Thank you for your consideration.

- Edit approximately **10–20 video ads per week**, depending on project length and complexity

- Add engaging captions, text overlays, visual effects, sound effects, and transitions where appropriate

- Handle urgent edits and revisions quickly

- Maintain organized project files, footage libraries, and editing assets

- Keep assigned projects updated and communicate blockers early

- Work closely with our creative strategist and creative team to execute ad concepts

- Review winning ads and creative references to identify editing patterns that improve performance

- Understand key creative metrics such as **CTR, Hook Rate, Hold Rate, and viewer retention**

- Iterate on underperforming creatives and produce new versions for testing

- Build reusable editing templates and systems to improve production speed

- Stay up to date with new AI models, ad trends, editing styles, and direct-response strategies



### REQUIREMENTS



- Minimum **1.5 years of professional video editing experience**

- Previous experience working with **DTC/e-commerce brands or creative agencies**

- Experience editing **paid Meta advertisements**

- Strong experience with **UGC ads, direct-response marketing, and VSLs**

- Reliable, responsive, and able to meet deadlines

- Fluent in English

Experience with **supplement, health, wellness, or e-commerce brands** is highly preferred.



### EDITING SOFTWARE



You should be highly proficient with at least one of the following:



- Adobe Premiere Pro

- After Effects

- CapCut

- DaVinci Resolve



### AI EXPERIENCE



AI video experience is highly preferred.



Experience with tools such as:



- Kling

- Veo

- Higgsfield

- HeyGen

- AI image generation tools

- Other modern AI video and image generation models



We want editors who actively learn new AI tools and workflows rather than relying on one editing method.



### COMPENSATION



- **$600 USD/month base salary**

title: Technical Onboarding & Automation Specialist (GoHighLevel / Zapier) – Night Shift, Client-Facing
Dispatch Agent - Local Services
description:
Dispatch Agent — Local Services (UK)

We're hiring 2–3 remote Dispatch Agents for our UK local-services brands. You'll take customer calls, book jobs in and dispatch the right local tradesperson.



The details:

• Hours: 8am–8pm UK time, seven days a week

• Shifts: split between two or more people, for example a 3-day and 4-day rota, or 5 and 2. We'll agree whatever works best

• Pay: $3–$6.50 per hour, based on experience

• Location: remote

• Start: a two-week paid trial

• US hours: we're opening a US branch, so let us know if you're interested in US hours too



The role:

We run local home-services brands across the UK, covering plumbing, drainage, roofing and more. Each brand has one phone number. Every job goes to an independent local partner company, which quotes, does the work and invoices the customer directly. As Dispatch Agent, you connect the two.



Responsibilities:

1. Answer every call with energy, as the brand the customer rang. Take their name, mobile, postcode and the problem.

2. Dispatch. Ring our partner technicians to find who can attend soonest.

3. Book. Call the customer back within 10 minutes, confirm the slot, and put the job in our CRM (GoHighLevel) with the tech assigned.

4. Follow up. Keep notes and job stages up to date until the job is complete. Escalate complaints the same day.

5. Invoice. Send invoices to our partner companies once jobs are complete.

Never quote prices or arrival times, take payment, say "our plumbers" or "our crews", or claim that anyone is licensed, insured or vetted.



Requirements:

• A clear British or American English accent

• You must be high energy and ambitious

• Reliable availability for your agreed shifts, between 8am and 8pm UK time

• At least one year of phone, reception or dispatch experience. Trades experience is a plus

• Attention to detail: begin your application with the exact words "Booked and texted". Applications that don't will not be reviewed

• An expectation of excitement whenever you answer every call. That's how we answer today

• A quiet workspace, a noise-cancelling headset and reliable internet

• Confidence with a CRM, and calm under pressure



How to apply:

Message us with your experience, the days you'd like to work (UK hours, US hours, or both) and your hourly rate. The first thing I'll ask for is an MP3 of you reading the script below, so attach it to your first message. Record it in one take, on your work headset, with no editing or filters.

Once I've responded and you've sent your MP3, I'll invite you to a call with me this week. Interviews are on 5 and 6 October, and we're looking to hire 2–3 people by 7 October.



"Good morning, thanks for calling. How can I help? Oh no, a leak through the ceiling. Let's get you sorted. Can I take your name, mobile and postcode? That's 14 Wellington Road, TW2 5HQ. Perfect. I'll check which local partner company can get to you soonest and call you back within ten minutes.

Good news: a partner can be with you between two and four this afternoon. They're their own business, so they'll quote before any work starts and invoice you directly. I'll text you their details now."

title: Bookkeeper - Virtual
description:
Role Title: Bookkeeper

Company: By The 10th, an emerging AI-powered accounting and bookkeeping firm

Reports To: Founders

Location: Remote - Philippines-based candidates

Work Schedule: Part-time to start, expected to grow to full-time as the client base grows. Must be available during US overlap hours (9am–5pm MST).

Compensation: $4.00 USD/hour to start, with growth opportunities as the firm grows



About Us

By The 10th is an early-stage accounting and bookkeeping firm that combines AI automation with expert human oversight to deliver fast, accurate, and affordable financials to small businesses, every month, by the 10th. Many of our clients are in the real estate industry, including rental property owners. We are building our team now, and this is a true ground-floor opportunity to grow with us from day one.



Role Purpose

The Bookkeeper is the expert eye behind our AI. Using our proprietary AI software and workflow, you will review and correct AI-coded transactions, produce accurate financial statements and reports, and make sure every client receives their financials by the 10th of each month. This role is about ownership: catching what the AI misses, keeping your clients' books clean, and helping us improve the process as we scale.



Key Responsibilities



1. Accurate Books:

- Keep every assigned client's books clean and correct.

- AI review & correction: Review AI-coded transactions in our proprietary software and correct any miscategorized or unclear items.

- Categorization & property allocation: Categorize transactions accurately and consistently across all assigned clients, and allocate each transaction to the correct property for real estate and rental clients.

- Quality: Spot patterns in AI errors and flag them so the workflow can be improved.

- Confidentiality: Protect client information and handle sensitive financial data with care.



2. Financial Reporting by the 10th:

- Deliver on the promise in our name.

- Statements & reports: Generate monthly financial statements and reports using our proprietary AI software.

- On-time delivery: Deliver financials to every assigned client by the 10th of each month.

- Deadline tracking: Track month-end deadlines and raise any risk to the founders early, with a proposed solution.



3. Client Support:

- Be a clear, reliable point of contact for your clients.

- Information requests: Request documents and clarification on unclear transactions, and follow up until resolved.

- Client questions: Respond professionally to client questions about their books and reports, escalating to the founders when needed.

- Process improvement: Share ideas to make the workflow faster, more accurate, and easier for clients.



Requirements

- Minimum 3 years of bookkeeping or accounting experience

- Experience with real estate or rental property bookkeeping is a strong plus

- Strong written English communication skills

- Highly detail-oriented, organized, and able to meet firm monthly deadlines

- Comfortable learning new software, including proprietary AI tools (we will train you on our system)

- Self-directed and comfortable in an early-stage, evolving environment

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet remote work setup

- Experience with AI tools is helpful but not required



Success in This Role Looks Like...

Accurate Books - AI-coded work is reviewed and corrected thoroughly, and supervisor reviews turn up very few errors.

Financial Reporting by the 10th - Every client receives accurate financials by the 10th, every month.

Client Support - Clients get clear, timely answers and feel confident in their numbers.

KPI Achievement - Books closed and financials delivered by the 10th: 100%, Low error rate on supervisor review, Maintain the client load set by the founders



Compensation & Growth

Starting rate: $4.00 USD/hour, part-time to start.

Hours: Expected to grow to full-time as the firm acquires more clients.

Growth: As a new and growing company, we offer a ground-floor opportunity, with raises and expanded responsibility as the firm grows.



How to Apply

Reply to this job post with “By the 10th” in the subject line.

- any relevant experience with AI you have (not required but helpful)

description:
I run an Instagram page that turns viral social media posts into "card news" carousels: a cover photo with a headline, a screenshot-style slide of the original post and its top comments, and a short caption. We publish 9 posts every day.



You will not design from scratch. We have our own web app that does most of the work: paste a link and it builds the slides and caption in about a minute. Your job is to run that pipeline every day, check that everything looks right, and get all 9 posts scheduled on time.



What you will do every day:



Open the queue: 9 links, added by me.

For each link, generate the carousel in our app and check it against the checklist: headline fits on two lines and nothing is cut off; cover photo matches the story, and if not, regenerate it or pick another photo; screenshot slide shows the post, counts and comments correctly; all slides and the caption are complete, with no blank or broken parts.

Send post for approval through the app and message me on WhatsApp.

Once approved, schedule it in Meta Business Suite at the agreed time slot and mark it scheduled in the app.



Who I am looking for:



Has scheduled Instagram posts before, ideally with Meta Business Suite or a scheduler like Later or Buffer.

Detail-oriented. This job is mostly checking, and a wrong cover photo or a cut-off headline going live is the one thing we cannot have. If you enjoy spotting the one wrong thing on a page, you will like this.

Reliable every single day, including weekends and holidays, without reminders. If you need a day off, you tell me in advance.

Communicates clearly and quickly on WhatsApp.

Reliable internet and a laptop or desktop. A phone alone is not enough.

Bonus: interest in Korean online culture or trending topics. Korean language is not required.



What you get:

A tool that does the heavy lifting, so the work stays consistent and predictable

A clear approval flow: you always know what is waiting on you and what is waiting on me

title: Senior Video Editor & Creative Strategist — Ecommerce, Meta Ads & VSLs
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Video Editor and Creative Strategist to take ownership of performance creatives for our ecommerce brands.



We currently generate five-figure daily revenue and are scaling toward six figures per day. We need someone who can deliver at that pace, think independently, and connect creative decisions to business results.



You must have hands-on experience creating video ads for Scandinavian ecommerce brands and other European markets. Please include relevant examples in your application.



THE ROLE



You will own the creative process from research and concept development through scripting, editing, performance analysis, and iteration.



We will provide winning ads, customer insights, and performance data so you understand what has worked. Your job is to turn those insights into fresh concepts, stronger angles, and original executions.



Simply copying existing ads, changing captions, or swapping clips is not enough. You should understand why an ad works and use that understanding to create something new.



We expect you to identify what is needed, make informed decisions, and deliver without requiring detailed instructions for every script, scene, or edit.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



• Develop original ad concepts, hooks, angles, and scripts based on customer motivations, objections, product positioning, and performance insights.



• Create short-form direct-response ads, UGC-style creatives, product demonstrations, and longer video sales letters.



• Plan and produce B-roll, including original AI-generated footage where appropriate, and source suitable licensed assets when needed.



• Build complete ads with strong pacing, clear storytelling, effective voiceovers, readable captions, sound design, and relevant visuals.



• Adapt creatives for Scandinavian and other European audiences, paying attention to language, cultural context, credibility, and buying behavior.



• Analyze creative performance using metrics such as hook rate, retention, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, and ROAS. Understand these metrics in the context of spend, audience, offer, and landing-page performance.



• Identify why an ad is succeeding or underperforming, then propose specific changes and new tests.



• Maintain an organized creative testing process with clear hypotheses, consistent file naming, and documented learnings.



WHAT WE REQUIRE



• Proven experience editing direct-response video ads for Scandinavian brands and other EU ecommerce markets.



• A portfolio demonstrating both strong editing and strategic thinking.



• Experience writing original scripts and building VSLs with a clear hook, problem, product explanation, proof, objection handling, and call to action.



• The ability to turn customer research and performance data into creative decisions.



• Strong judgment when selecting or creating B-roll. Visuals should support the message and product accurately.



• Reliable communication, fast execution, attention to detail, and the ability to manage several creative tests at once.



• Ownership of the work: proactively suggest ideas, flag missing information, solve problems, and follow through.



• Your own editing software, creative tools, and any subscriptions needed to produce the work.



Success in this role means consistently producing fresh, well-reasoned creatives, learning from their performance, and improving the next round of ads.



IMPORTANT — UNPAID TRIAL AD



If your portfolio is shortlisted, you will be asked to create one unpaid trial ad so we can assess your actual editing, scripting, and creative strategy skills.



You must use your own software, tools, and subscriptions to complete the test.



Please apply only if you accept these conditions and can independently deliver work that matches the quality of your portfolio. This helps both sides avoid wasting time.



IMPORTANT — WRITE YOUR OWN APPLICATION



AI-generated applications will be ignored and will not receive a response.



Write your application in your own words. We want specific examples of your experience, your contribution to the work, and how you think about creative performance. Generic cover letters and copy-paste answers will not be considered.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



Three to five relevant ads you personally worked on, including at least one VSL or longer direct-response video.



The Scandinavian and European brands or markets you have worked with. If client names are confidential, describe the market, product category, and your responsibilities.



Your exact contribution to each example: strategy, research, scripting, B-roll, editing, or the complete process.



One example of how you used performance data to improve a creative. Explain the problem, what you changed, and the result. Redacted screenshots are welcome where you have permission to share them.



The tools you use for editing, research, B-roll production, and AI-assisted creative work.



Your weekly availability, earliest start date, and expected hourly or monthly rate.



Confirmation that you understand and accept the unpaid trial requirement and will use your own tools.



We are hiring as soon as possible and are looking for a reliable, long-term collaborator. Applications with relevant work examples and clear evidence of independent thinking will receive priority.

title: Davinci Resolve Colorist
description:
About Us



Ryo Jaeger Productions (RJP) is a Hawaiʻi-based video production company specializing in commercial, branded, corporate, real estate, hospitality, and social media content.



We work with a diverse range of clients, from small businesses to established brands, producing everything from cinematic brand films and interviews to commercial campaigns and short-form social media reels. We're currently a small team of two: myself, Ryo, the owner and lead videographer based in Honolulu, and our video editor based in Manila.



As our client base and production volume continue to grow, we're looking to bring on a dedicated DaVinci Resolve Colorist to help elevate the overall visual quality of our productions.



The Role



We're looking for someone with a strong eye for color, consistency, and image quality. Our current bottleneck is color grading. While our editing workflow is established, we want to improve the finishing quality of our videos, particularly when it comes to:



Creating crisp, clean, professional-looking images without excessive softness, haze, or washed-out colors.

Maintaining consistent color temperatures and skin tones across interviews, real estate videos, and commercial projects.

Properly balancing exposure, contrast, saturation, and white balance.

Developing cinematic looks that complement each project's creative direction.

Maintaining visual consistency across multiple cameras, lighting conditions, and shooting environments.

Ensuring our social media reels look polished and retain their visual quality across platforms.



You'll work closely with our Manila-based editor, receiving locked timelines and source footage for grading before returning the finished material for final delivery. Our projects are shot on the A7siii, using SLOG3. 



The color grader will be hired at a minimum of 10 hours/month, with the option of increasing scope for any month.



Requirements



Strong proficiency in DaVinci Resolve, particularly its color grading tools.

A portfolio demonstrating professional color correction and creative grading.

Experience working with Sony S-Log3 footage.

Understanding of color management, color spaces, skin tones, and delivery formats.

Familiarity with Premiere Pro to DaVinci Resolve workflows, including XML round-tripping.

Ability to independently troubleshoot footage and identify technical issues.

Someone who reads instructions. In your reply to me, tell me about which animal you most identify with.

Reliable internet connection and sufficient local storage to download, manage, and archive large video projects.

Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

Ability to meet deadlines and work independently in a remote environment.

Experience grading commercial, real estate, interview, and social media content is highly preferred.



Who We're Looking For



Technical ability is important, but we're equally interested in finding the right person to join our small team. We're looking for someone who:



Takes ownership: Goes above and beyond the assigned task, identifies issues proactively, and takes pride in delivering excellent work.

Communicates well: Keeps the team informed, asks questions when necessary, and is comfortable collaborating remotely.

Has attention to detail: Notices inconsistencies that others might overlook and doesn't settle for a grade that's simply good enough.

Works well in small teams: Understands that we're a growing production company, not a large agency with multiple departments.

Is adaptable: Comfortable working across different industries, creative styles, and project requirements.

Wants to grow with us: We're looking to establish a long-term working relationship with someone who can become an important part of RJP as we continue to expand.

We value initiative. If you see an opportunity to improve our workflow, image quality, or overall production standards, we want to hear your ideas.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Job Title: Operations Manager (Part-Time, Remote — Philippines)

Location: Remote (Philippines-based)



About Us

We're an early-stage, technology-driven CPA and bookkeeping firm combining AI automation with expert oversight to deliver fast, accurate, and affordable accounting services to small businesses and property owners. We're building the operational backbone now, and we're looking for a detail-oriented Operations Manager to grow with us from day one.



Role Overview

As our first Operations Manager, you'll own the day-to-day operational infrastructure that keeps the firm running smoothly — client onboarding, scheduling, internal systems, and process documentation — while working closely with the founder as the client base scales. This is a foundational role with real upside: as we grow, your hours and compensation grow with it.

- 5+ years of experience in operations, executive assistance, or administrative management (accounting/bookkeeping firm experience a plus, not required)

- Comfortable with tools like Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack, QuickBooks Online, and general SaaS platforms (we'll train on our specific stack)

- Highly organized, self-directed, and comfortable in an early-stage, evolving environment

Compensation & Growth Structure

Reply to this job post with "Ops Expert" in the subject line.

- what are your preferred working hours?

- what sets you apart from other applicants?



***Applications that do NOT follow these instructions will be automatically disqualified without opening.

title: Executive Virtual Assistant | GoHighLevel & Business Operations
description:
Company: Lead Us Enterprise LLC

Position: Part-Time, Long-Term Virtual Assistant

Work Arrangement: Remote

Hours: Approximately 20 hours per week to start



PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

This is a long-term Virtual Assistant position. This is NOT a project-based GoHighLevel job.



I am looking for someone who wants to become an ongoing part of my company and help manage the day-to-day backend operations of the business.



GoHighLevel experience is required because you will be responsible for helping build, maintain, troubleshoot, and improve our CRM, workflows, pipelines, and automations. However, GoHighLevel is only one part of this position.



Once the initial systems are built, your job does not end.



You will continue working with the company as a Virtual Assistant, helping manage leads, follow-ups, appointments, onboarding, organization, reporting, administrative tasks, and other ongoing backend responsibilities.



If you are only interested in completing a GoHighLevel setup/build and then moving on to another project, please do not apply.



About the Position

Lead Us Enterprise LLC is a growing tax preparation and business services company.



As the owner, I am looking to remove myself from many of the repetitive backend responsibilities of the business so I can spend more time generating revenue, recruiting, training, creating content, building relationships, and growing the company.



I need someone who can eventually become my right hand on the administrative and operations side of the business.



I am not looking for someone who needs to wait for instructions every day. I will provide direction and training on how my company operates, but I want someone who can learn the business, follow systems, recognize what needs attention, and take ownership of their responsibilities.



GoHighLevel Responsibilities

You will help:

- Manage and organize our GoHighLevel CRM

- Build and maintain pipelines

- Build workflows and automations

- Create forms and surveys

- Set up calendars and appointment systems

- Create automated
 and SMS follow-up

- Tag and segment contacts

- Organize leads by source and status

- Build and maintain recruiting workflows

- Build and maintain client follow-up systems

- Create appointment reminders and no-show follow-up

- Assist with funnels and landing pages when needed

- Test automations to make sure they are working correctly

- Troubleshoot GoHighLevel issues

- Clean and organize CRM data

- Recommend ways GoHighLevel can eliminate repetitive manual work

- Document systems and automations



Ongoing Virtual Assistant & Business Operations Responsibilities

This is an equally important part of the position.



Responsibilities may include:

- Monitor incoming leads

- Follow up with prospects using approved scripts

- Keep leads moving through the appropriate pipelines

- Manage appointment scheduling and rescheduling

- Follow up with no-shows

- Monitor company
 and identify items requiring my attention

- Assist with calendar management

- Track recruiting prospects

- Assist with new tax preparer onboarding

- Track onboarding requirements and outstanding tasks

- Maintain spreadsheets and business trackers

- Organize Google Drive and company files

- Perform data entry and CRM updates

- Create and maintain SOPs

- Conduct basic business research when needed

- Assist with routine client communication

- Coordinate with other team members and contractors

- Help keep projects, deadlines, and recurring tasks organized

- Prepare weekly reports showing leads, appointments, follow-ups, outstanding tasks, and items requiring my attention

- Handle other reasonable administrative and operational responsibilities as the company grows



What a Typical Week May Look Like

This position will not look exactly the same every day.



One day you may be building or troubleshooting a GoHighLevel workflow. Another day you may be following up with leads, updating pipelines, checking appointments, organizing files, updating a spreadsheet, documenting a process, assisting with onboarding, or completing other administrative work.



I am specifically looking for someone who enjoys both the technical GoHighLevel side AND the day-to-day Virtual Assistant and business operations side of the position.



What I Am Looking For

You should be:

- Experienced with GoHighLevel

- Experienced with workflows, pipelines, automations, forms, calendars,
 and SMS campaigns

- Comfortable performing general Virtual Assistant duties

- Organized and detail-oriented

- Reliable and consistent

- A strong written communicator

- Comfortable learning new systems

- Able to follow instructions and SOPs

- Able to work independently

- Proactive when you notice a problem or something that needs attention

- Comfortable suggesting better ways to complete repetitive tasks

- Able to manage multiple responsibilities

- Comfortable working with confidential business information

- Interested in a long-term working relationship



Experience supporting a tax, accounting, financial services, professional services, or lead-generation company is a plus, but not required.



This Position Is NOT For You If:

- You are only looking for GoHighLevel implementation projects

- You only want to build automations and leave once they are completed

- You are not interested in general Virtual Assistant or administrative responsibilities

- You need detailed instructions for every task before taking action

- You are currently overloaded with clients and cannot consistently dedicate time to this position

- You are looking for occasional freelance projects instead of an ongoing position



To Apply

Important: This is an ongoing Virtual Assistant position, not a one-time GoHighLevel project. I am specifically looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of the Lead Us Enterprise team.

title: Track and Trace Assistant
description:
GH Logistics is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and reefer freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, on track, and moving cleanly from pickup to delivery. If you’re someone who enjoys staying engaged, solving live challenges, and being part of a fast moving operations team, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

As a Track & Trace Assistant, you serve as part of the operational backbone, ensuring shipments are accurately monitored, risks are identified early, and critical information reaches the right people at the right time. if you thrive behind the scenes keeping operations running smoothly, this role is an excellent fit.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Updating assigned sections of the Tracking Dashboard with accurate ETAs, locations, mileage, and notes

• Communicating with carriers via
 and internal channels to gather updates or resolve missing information

• Verifying that carriers are properly assigned, accepted, and actively tracking in required platforms

• Monitoring multiple communication channels to prevent missed updates

• Proactively flagging delays, risks, and irregularities, and escalating when necessary

• Coordinating with the Booking Team to confirm ETAs for time sensitive shipments

• Ensuring clean shift handoffs through verbal (Zoom) and written updates

• Follows instructions consistently and executes with precision

• Team oriented, coachable, and open to feedback without ego

• Minimum of 45 words per minute



What Success Looks Like

• Assigned tracking sections are consistently accurate and up to date

• Scheduled updates are sent on time

title: Full-Cycle Outbound Sales Representative – Website Design
description:
Capital Designz helps local service businesses improve their online presence with professional websites designed to generate calls, leads, and service requests.



We create personalized website demos for selected businesses before contacting them. We are hiring a part-time Full-Cycle Outbound Sales Representative who can contact business owners, present their personalized website demos, follow up consistently, and close website sales.



This is a sales position. It is not an administrative virtual-assistant position, and it is not limited to appointment setting.



ABOUT THE POSITION



Capital Designz will provide qualified prospect information, personalized website demos, approved packages, pricing, sales scripts, payment links, training, and a system for tracking prospects.



Your job will be to contact business owners, introduce the personalized demo, explain how the website could help their business, handle objections, follow up, and ask for the sale.



You will be expected to close straightforward website packages. Custom, high-value, or technically complex opportunities will be transferred to the owner with complete notes.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Make outbound calls to U.S.-based business owners  

• Introduce Capital Designz professionally  

• Explain why we created a personalized website demo for the prospect  

• Send approved demo links by text or
  

• Walk interested prospects through their personalized demo  

• Ask questions about the business, its customers, and its website needs  

• Explain approved website packages, promotional pricing, and monthly care plans  

• Handle common objections professionally  

• Confidently ask qualified prospects to move forward  

• Send customers the official Capital Designz checkout or invoice link  

• Confirm when the customer has completed the approved payment process  

• Schedule and complete callbacks with interested prospects  

• Follow up consistently by telephone,
, or text  

• Record accurate notes, call outcomes, objections, and follow-up dates  

• Collect the required business and project information after a sale  

• Submit an organized project handoff to the Capital Designz production team  

• Transfer custom or complex opportunities to the owner with complete notes  

• Report common objections, customer requests, and sales-process problems  



Capital Designz currently has a promotional $299 starter website offer for eligible businesses. More complex websites are priced according to their pages, functionality, integrations, and other requirements.



CUSTOM AND COMPLEX OPPORTUNITIES



The representative should transfer an opportunity to the owner when:



• The customer requests custom software or advanced functionality  

• The project requires extensive e-commerce or unusual integrations  

• The customer wants multiple websites  

• The requested work falls outside the approved packages or pricing  

• The customer requests a major discount or contract negotiation  

• The representative is uncertain whether a requested feature can be delivered  

• The opportunity could become a larger or higher-value project  



The representative must not promise unapproved prices, discounts, features, or completion dates.



FOLLOW-UP EXPECTATIONS



Following up is an essential part of this position. The representative will not be expected to spend every working hour making new cold calls.



Daily working time will be divided among:



• New outbound calls  

• Scheduled callbacks  

• Personalized demo walkthroughs  

• Follow-up calls  

• Text and
 follow-ups  

• Prospect notes and status updates  

• Project-information collection after a sale  



Every interested prospect should receive:



• The demo link promptly after the initial conversation  

• A confirmation message by text or
  

• A first follow-up within one business day  

• A second follow-up approximately two or three business days later  

• A final follow-up approximately seven days later  

• A specific callback date and time whenever possible  



The representative should never record “follow up later” without entering a specific follow-up date.



QUALIFICATIONS



• Strong spoken and written English  

• A clear, confident, friendly, and professional telephone voice  

• Previous experience with cold calling, outbound sales, appointment setting, telemarketing, or closing  

• Comfortable speaking with U.S.-based business owners  

• Able to follow a structured sales process without sounding robotic  

• Comfortable presenting and discussing a website through a live demo link  

• Able to listen, ask useful questions, handle objections, and confidently ask for the sale  

• Strong follow-up and recordkeeping habits  

• Able to recognize when an opportunity should be transferred to the owner  

• Reliable, coachable, honest, organized, and motivated by results  

• Reliable computer, professional headset, stable internet connection, and quiet working environment  

• Available during agreed U.S. Eastern business hours  

• Comfortable learning CRM software, AI-assisted systems, and website-demo tools  



Experience selling websites, digital marketing, SEO, advertising, SaaS, or other services to small businesses is strongly preferred.



COMPENSATION



• Starting base pay of $4 USD per hour  

• 20 working hours per week  

• Two-week paid trial  

• 10% commission on every paid website setup fee personally closed  

• 25% of the customer’s first successful monthly care-plan payment  

• 5% commission on an approved custom opportunity transferred to the owner and later closed  

• Base-pay review after the first 30 days  

• Opportunity for increased base pay, additional hours, and advancement based on performance  



Commission examples:



• A $299 website sale earns approximately $30  

• A $500 website sale earns $50  

• A $1,000 website sale earns $100  



Commission is calculated from the website setup fee successfully collected by Capital Designz.



Refunded, canceled, fraudulent, duplicate, unpaid, or unauthorized transactions do not qualify for commission. Commission terms and payment timing will be explained before the representative begins work.



SCHEDULE



• Approximately four working hours per day, Monday through Friday  

• 20 total working hours per week  

• Working hours must overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours  

• The representative must be available for scheduled prospect callbacks  

• The exact working schedule will be agreed upon before hiring  

• Hours may increase based on sales performance, prospect volume, and company growth  



CUSTOMER PAYMENTS



Customers will pay through an official Capital Designz checkout or invoice link.



The representative must never request, write down, receive, or store a customer’s complete payment-card information. The representative must never accept customer payments through a personal account or create unauthorized payment links.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the words “PREMIUM DEMO CLOSER” so we know you read the complete posting.



Please provide:



1. A short introduction  

2. A summary of your cold-calling and sales-closing experience  

3. The products or services you have previously sold  

4. Whether you have sold to U.S.-based business owners  

5. Any experience selling websites, digital marketing, SaaS, or business services  

6. Your normal availability in Philippine Time  

7. The corresponding hours you can work in U.S. Eastern Time  

8. The sales, CRM, calling,
, and messaging tools you have used  

9. Your computer, internet connection, and headset information  

10. A link to a 60–90 second voice recording  



VOICE RECORDING INSTRUCTIONS



First, read the following script naturally:



“Hi, is this the owner of [Business Name]?



My name is [Your Name] with Capital Designz. I’ll be brief—I came across your business while researching [mobile detailers/business type] in [City].



I noticed that [you don’t currently have a website / your current website could do a better job showcasing your work and generating service requests].



I went ahead and created a personalized website preview using your business information so you could see what an updated online presence could look like. It includes your services, contact information, strong calls to action, and a form customers can use to request service.



I’m not asking you to purchase anything without seeing it. Would you be open to taking a quick look at the preview?”



After reading the script, respond naturally to these objections:



1. “I’m busy. Just send me the information.”



2. “The demo looks good, but I need to think about it.”



Conclude by attempting to close the sale or secure a specific callback date and time.



Please do not submit a generic application. We will evaluate your communication, confidence, sales judgment, objection handling, follow-up ability, reliability, attention to detail, and ability to close.

title: Live-Stream Moderator - Hourly Base + Commission | Growing Agency
description:
About Us

We are a creator management agency building a core team around our model's live-stream operations. We're a lean, fast-moving operation where the people who join now have a direct path to senior and leadership roles as we scale over the coming months.

We're not looking for someone to passively watch a chat scroll by. We're looking for someone who can control a room, protect the model's energy, and actively drive revenue - all at the same time.



The Role

As a Live-Stream Moderator, you are the backbone of the live stream. The model performs - you manage everything happening in the chat behind the scenes. You keep the energy high, remove bad actors instantly, engage viewers to stay longer, and push tips and purchases at the right moments without it feeling forced.

This is a fast-paced, real-time role. Slow reactions cost money. Good moderation makes the difference between a $200 stream and a $2,000 stream.

Day-to-day responsibilities:

Monitor and manage live chat in real time during scheduled streams

Remove, mute, and ban trolls, time-wasters, and rule-breakers immediately

Engage active viewers to maintain energy and encourage tipping

Pin strategic messages and tip goals at the right moments

Upsell PPV content, tip menus, and offers naturally during the stream

Relay relevant information or opportunities to the model without breaking her flow

Track stream performance and report key metrics after each session



Schedule

title: Remote Cold Caller – AI Phone Receptionist for US Trade Businesses (US Pacific hours)
description:
We're a small US software company near Seattle, hiring 1 remote caller, starting with a paid two-week trial.



Hours: Full-time, 7-8 hours per day, Monday-Friday, US Pacific business hours (overnight in the Philippines).

Pay: Base plus commission on every paid setup. A good performer earns around $1,000/month all-in. Paid two-week trial to start.



WHAT WE DO

We make an AI phone receptionist for small trade businesses: plumbers, painters, electricians, HVAC. When the owner is on a job and can't answer, the AI answers as their company, takes the caller's name and number, and promises a callback. It's built from the customer's own website in minutes. Plans are $50-150/month.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Call locally owned trade businesses in the US (we start with plumbers in Portland, Oregon) from our calling system. You'll ramp from 40 to 60 to 80 dials a day over the first weeks. Most calls hit voi
. The ones that connect get your full attention.

- Run a short, honest opening (we don't hide that it's a cold call), ask one real question, and listen.

- Offer a live demo: you bring the AI receptionist into the call and the owner hears her answering as their own company. The demo does most of the selling.

- Close to a paid start: a $100 setup fee that includes the first month of service. Send the payment link, confirm it went through, log the call.

- Log every dial honestly in our system. We review call recordings every day.

- Work directly with the founder. Daily 15-minute coaching call in the first weeks, then a few times a week.



WHAT WE NEED

- Real outbound cold-calling or appointment-setting experience for US or English-speaking clients. Tell us your numbers: dials per day, connects, appointments or sales.

- Clear, warm, unhurried spoken English. Clarity matters more than accent.

- Someone who listens. This job is not reading a script at people.

- Coachable. We give one note, you change it on the next call.

- Honest. Every disposition you log gets checked against recordings. If that sounds fair to you, you're our kind of person.

- Reliable at US Pacific hours from a quiet room, with a headset and stable internet.

- Comfortable with a dialer, a simple CRM-style tool, and conferencing a third party into a call.



NOT A FIT

- If you advertise 200+ dials a day, this isn't the job. That's robo-dialing, not selling.

- If most of your experience is consumer telemarketing (insurance leads, timeshares), it's probably not a fit. We call business owners.

- If you need a script for every sentence.



HOW TO APPLY (REQUIRED)

1. A 60-second voice recording, sent as a Google Drive or Vocaroo link. Read this cold, then talk for 30 seconds about the last thing you sold and how:

"Hi, is this Mike? My name is [your name]. I'll be straight with you, this is a cold call. I'm calling plumbers because most plumbers lose money every week when calls hit voi
, and we built a fix for it. Can I ask you one question?"

2. Your last cold-calling role with numbers: dials per day, connect rate, what you sold, how long you stayed, why you left.

3. Confirm you can work US Pacific hours and describe your setup (room, headset, internet).



Applications without the voice recording won't be reviewed.



HOW IT WORKS

We start with a paid two-week trial on a real list with real tools. If you dial consistently, listen, log honestly, and take coaching, the real role starts, month to month.

title: Research, Clean & Enrich Lead - B2B / M&A Data Operations
description:
Research, Clean & Enrich Lead - B2B / M&A Data Operations



Full-time | Remote | Philippines

$1,000–$1,200 USD/month to start



We’re a U.S.-based M&A firm.



Private equity firms and other buyers hire us to find companies they may want to acquire.



A buyer might ask us to find commercial HVAC companies, electrical testing businesses, ITAD/electronics recycling companies, control systems integrators, or another very specific type of company.



They give us a detailed mandate: what the company needs to do, geography, approximate size, end markets, what qualifies, what doesn’t, etc.



We need someone to own the Research → Clean → Enrich side of that process.



This is not an appointment-setting job and it’s not a basic “export a list from Apollo” role.



The job is to take a mandate and figure out the best way to build a large, accurate list of companies that actually fit it, then identify the right owner/founder/CEO and enrich the contact data.



The two things we care about most are:



1. Lead quality

Are these actually the right companies, the right size, and the right people?



2. Cost per qualified lead

Can we produce high-quality data without wasting money on unnecessary tools, credits, or manual work?



For each company, we generally want:



Company name



Website



Company LinkedIn



Short description of what they do



Approximate size / size proxy



Owner / Founder / CEO



Personal LinkedIn



Verified



Mobile number when possible



A big part of the role is figuring out where the companies actually are.



Apollo is useful, but we don’t want someone who only knows Apollo.



Depending on the industry, the best sources might be:



Industry associations



Certification or accreditation directories



Trade organizations



Member directories



Government or licensing databases



Trade show exhibitor lists



Niche databases



Google



LinkedIn



Apollo



Scraped websites/directories



Other industry-specific sources



You should be comfortable combining several sources, cleaning the data, removing duplicates, and building a much more complete company universe.



You’ll also help decide which companies actually fit the mandate.



We use AI heavily, but we do not want someone who blindly runs everything through ChatGPT or Claude and trusts the output.



The right person should understand how to combine:



AI



Automation



Rules



Human review



For example, maybe obvious bad fits can be removed automatically, obvious good fits can pass, and ambiguous companies go into a human-review bucket.



You should also be comfortable with company sizing.



Most of the companies we research are private, so revenue and EBITDA databases are often wrong. We may use things like LinkedIn employee count, locations, industry-specific thresholds, and other public signals instead.



On the enrichment side, you should understand waterfalls.



We don’t want to run every contact through the most expensive provider first.



You should understand how to test different providers, send failures to the next provider, verify the results, and figure out the best mix of cost and coverage.



You do not need to know every tool below, but experience with several of these is a strong plus:



Clay



Apollo



LinkedIn Sales Navigator



Prospeo



LeadMagic



BetterContact



Datagma



Hunter



RocketReach



ContactOut



Apify



ChatGPT



Claude



Perplexity



Google Sheets / Excel



Zapier



Make



n8n



APIs / Webhooks



Basic Python or JavaScript is a bonus.



What matters more than knowing a specific tool is understanding how the whole system works.



We’re looking for someone who:



Has built B2B research / list-building / enrichment workflows before



Understands enrichment waterfalls



Knows how to research obscure industries



Is comfortable with AI and automation



Understands basic APIs and data workflows



Can clean and deduplicate messy data



Thinks about cost, not just output volume



Can work independently



Communicates clearly



Makes recommendations instead of waiting for step-by-step instructions



Is willing to replace our current tools/process if there is a better way



Initial volume will be around 5,000 qualified leads per month, and that will grow.



We pay separately for approved software, data providers, enrichment credits, etc.



There is room for more responsibility and higher compensation if you build this well and become the person who owns the function.



To apply



Please don’t send a generic cover letter.



Start your application with the word WATERFALL and answer these questions:



1. We need 5,000 U.S. acquisition targets per month across several niche industries. Apollo only gives us part of the market. Where else would you look for companies?



2. We collect 8,000 companies from several sources, but only 3,000 actually fit the buyer’s criteria. How would you build a process to qualify them using AI, automation, rules, and human review?



3. How would you clean and deduplicate company data collected from multiple sources?



4. Design a basic enrichment waterfall for 5,000 U.S. contacts where we need LinkedIn, verified
, and preferably mobile numbers. Which tools would you consider and why?



5. How would you calculate the total cost per qualified usable lead?



6. Tell us about the most sophisticated research / list-building / enrichment system you have personally built. Include the volume, tools, what you built yourself, what you automated, and anything you changed or improved.



7. What monthly salary are you looking for?



Research finalists will receive a paid project.

 systems, and the automations behind them. This is a long-term part-time role, commencing with more hours on a backlog project. If it works well, hours and scope could grow.



WHAT THE FIRST 90 DAYS LOOK LIKE 

We have just opened a second office and we have a clear backlog of work ready for you — a booking system to check, location pages to build out, technical SEO to fix, and a content pipeline to get running. You will not be sitting waiting for tasks.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Website (WordPress)

1. Practical improvements to our existing WordPress site: such as clearer call-to-action buttons, additional book-an-appointment buttons, possibly more modern page layouts

2. Publish blog articles to our blog grid, formatted properly with images and internal links for SEO. Develop further so blogs can be sorted by category. 

3. Enhance the location pages for our two offices and the suburbs we service 

4. Check the set up of our appointment booking using Microsoft Bookings (we are on Microsoft 365) — multiple staff, two office locations, synced to Outlook calendars. Add a booking button to the site header and a sticky call/book bar on mobile

5. Build proper Contact, Our Team and individual solicitor pages (our navigation currently uses homepage anchors)

6. Publishing lead magnets: such as a downloadable guide in return for
 addresses.

7. On-page SEO: titles, meta descriptions, headings, image alt text, internal linking, schema where relevant

8. Add structured data (schema) to the site: Legal Service for both office locations, Person for each solicitor, FAQ Page on service pages, and Aggregate Rating for our Google reviews

9. Audit our Google Tag Manager and Analytics setup — we currently have two containers firing and suspect we are double-counting

10. Build and maintain Google Business Profiles for both offices, including posts, photos and Q&A

11. Fix legacy issues as you find them: internal links using http instead of https, mixed-content images, outdated footer content, duplicated page sections

12. Keep plugins, backups and page speed in order

13. General maintenance. You audit. We do not want to be the ones who discover a broken contact link six months from now. We expect you to check things, find problems, and raise them



 and automation

1. Set up automated
 nurture sequences for new leads in MailChimp. You don’t necessarily need to write the copy – we can arrange for someone else to do that if it isn’t your skillset.

2. Build forms and landing pages for lead magnets, and connect them to the right list and sequence

3. Set up and maintain tracking so we can see what is actually working



Other

1. Connect our Instagram account to our
 page so content posts to both

2. Upload webinar recordings to our YouTube channel with titles, descriptions and thumbnails

3. General "make this work properly" tasks as they come up

4. Might possibly assist with Google ads in time, but this is not priority just now



OUR SETUP

• WordPress, built with Themify, hosted on Siteground

• SEO plugin: YOAST. Forms: Themify

• Microsoft 365 for
 and calendars. MailChimp for marketing
. Canva for graphics

• Tell us honestly how comfortable you are with our page builder. This is critical. We would rather know upfront than find out in week three



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

• Demonstrated hands-on WordPress experience — you can edit layouts, fix things that break, and make a page look good without a developer

• Practical on-page SEO knowledge 

• Experience building
 automations in MailChimp, or a very close equivalent you can show us

• Good written English. You will not be writing our marketing copy, but you will be writing to us every day

• You tell us when something is a bad idea, rather than just doing it, and make suggestions as to what we might need

• Reliable. We would rather have someone steady for three years than someone brilliant for three months

• You will have access to our website,
 systems and marketing tools. You will not have access to client files or matters, but you will sign a confidentiality agreement before we start. We are a law firm and we take this seriously

• Nice to have: Google Analytics/Search Console, Canva, basic HTML/CSS, experience with professional services or legal clients.



HOURS 

• Phase 1: approximately 80–100 hours over the first 8 weeks (around 12–15 hours per week) to clear a defined backlog.

• Phase 2: ongoing maintenance and publishing at around 10 hours per week.

• Some overlap with Sydney business hours preferred

• You must remain contactable, and in regular contact

• ₱425–600/hr, paid in AUD



HOW TO APPLY

Applications that ignore these steps will not be read.

1. Put "WORDPRESS - BEECROFT" in your subject line.

2. Send us your CV so we can learn more about you and your skills and experience

3. Send us links to two WordPress sites you have worked on, and tell us in one or two sentences what you specifically did on each.

4. Go to 
 and spend ten minutes on it. Tell us the three things you would fix first and why. Be specific and be blunt — we are not looking for compliments. 

5. Tell us what
 platforms you have built automations in.

6. Tell us your available hours in Sydney & Philippine time.
