title: Facebook & Instagram Ads Specialist
description:
About Us



We are a fast-growing online trading education company that helps aspiring traders develop skills in chart analysis, market structure, risk management, and trading psychology through live Zoom classes, webinars, community support, and high-ticket mentorship programs.

Our funnels, CRM, webinar systems, and backend operations are already built and running.

We are now looking for an experienced
 & Instagram Ads Specialist to take ownership of our paid traffic campaigns and help us generate a consistent flow of qualified webinar registrations.

This is a performance-focused role, not a social media management position.

We are looking for someone who understands paid traffic, lead generation, retargeting, creative testing, tracking, optimization, and scaling.



Your Core Role

You will manage
 and Instagram advertising campaigns that drive qualified prospects into our existing webinar funnel.



Your primary goal is to:

Generate consistent, high-quality webinar registrations while maintaining efficient advertising costs and improving overall funnel performance.

You will be expected to analyze the numbers, identify opportunities, test strategically, and make decisions based on performance data.



 & Instagram Ads Management

You will be responsible for:



Creating, launching, and managing
 and Instagram ad campaigns

Building campaigns for webinar registrations and lead generation

Managing campaign structure, audiences, budgets, and optimization

Monitoring CPL, CTR, CPM, conversion rates, and lead quality

Managing daily budget allocation

Testing cold audiences and targeting strategies

Testing different campaign and ad-set structures

Identifying underperforming campaigns and taking corrective action

Identifying winning campaigns and creatives

Scaling successful campaigns while maintaining efficiency

Monitoring ad fatigue and campaign performance

Making ongoing optimization decisions based on data



Retargeting Campaigns

You will build and manage retargeting campaigns for:

Website visitors

Landing page visitors who did not register

Video viewers at 25%, 50%, 75%, and 95%

Webinar registrants who did not attend

Webinar attendees who did not purchase

Other relevant warm audiences

You will also help develop retargeting campaigns around:

Webinar reminders

Replay campaigns

Enrollment deadlines

Limited-time offers

Urgency campaigns

Re-engagement campaigns

The goal is to maximize the value of traffic we are already paying for.



Creative Testing & Optimization

You will work with our existing video and static creative assets and continuously test:

Hooks

Headlines

Primary text

Calls to action

Video variations

Static creatives

Messaging angles

Offers

Audience and creative combinations

You should be able to identify why an ad is performing well or poorly, not simply report the numbers.

You will provide recommendations on:

Which creatives should be scaled

Which creatives should be refreshed

Which hooks are generating stronger results

Which messaging angles are producing better leads

When creative fatigue is occurring

What new creative concepts should be tested



Funnel Performance

You will work with our existing webinar funnel and evaluate performance beyond the initial lead.

Where data is available, you should be comfortable looking at:

Ad → Landing Page → Registration → Attendance → Offer → Purchase

We are not simply looking for the cheapest leads.

Lead quality and downstream conversion matter.



Tracking & Attribution

You should have experience with advertising tracking and attribution, including:

Meta Pixel

Conversion API (CAPI)

Custom conversions

Standard events

UTM parameters

Event tracking

Conversion tracking

Troubleshooting tracking issues

Identifying discrepancies between Meta and funnel/CRM data

You should understand how to use tracking data to make better campaign decisions.



Reporting

You will provide a weekly performance report covering:

Total ad spend

Leads generated

Cost per lead (CPL)

Webinar registrations

Registration conversion rate

Retargeting performance

Campaign performance

Ad-set performance

Best-performing creatives

Best-performing audiences

Creative testing results

Key performance changes

Recommended next steps

We want someone who can clearly explain:

What happened → Why it happened → What we should do next.



Required Experience



You should have:

Strong hands-on experience with
 & Instagram Ads Manager

Proven experience running lead-generation campaigns

Experience with webinar funnels, coaching, courses, or info products

Strong retargeting experience

Experience testing and optimizing ad creatives

Experience analyzing campaign performance data

Experience with Meta Pixel and conversion tracking

Ability to independently manage and optimize campaigns

Strong understanding of CPL, CTR, CPM, conversion rates, and lead quality

We strongly prefer candidates who can demonstrate actual campaign results.



Bonus Experience



Experience in any of the following is a plus:

Trading or investing education

Financial education marketing

High-ticket coaching or mentorship

Webinar funnels

Online courses

GoHighLevel

ClickFunnels

Kajabi

CRM and funnel tracking

Scaling larger advertising budgets



Compensation:

Performance incentives may also be available based on:

Cost per lead

Webinar registration volume

Lead quality

Campaign efficiency

Funnel performance

Successful scaling of ad spend

Ad spend

Leads generated

CPL

CTR

CPM

Conversion rate

Campaign duration

Case studies

Performance results

Hooks

Copy

Creative iteration

Application Requirement

Start your application with:

“WEBINAR ADS SPECIALIST”

Final Note

This is not a general social media manager position.

We are specifically looking for someone who can own
 and Instagram paid traffic performance and help us build a predictable flow of qualified webinar registrations.

You should be comfortable working with data, testing strategically, communicating clearly, and taking ownership of campaign performance.

Generate consistent, high-quality webinar registrations while improving campaign efficiency and building a 
 & Instagram advertising system.

title: Meta Ads Specialist — Lead Generation for U.S. Service Businesses
description:
Inner Views Media is a Dallas-based branding and marketing agency developing a managed content and demand service for personal brands and service businesses.



We’re looking for an experienced freelance Meta Ads Specialist to independently manage
 and Instagram lead-generation campaigns. Initial client onboarding is pending, so the start date and workload will be agreed before engagement. We’re seeking a reliable partner for an initial paid project, with potential for ongoing monthly work as client accounts are added.



THE ROLE



You will handle campaign setup, tracking, testing, optimization, and reporting. Inner Views will manage client relationships, overall marketing direction, and content production.



Our initial target clients include coaches, consultants, personal brands, and local service businesses. Expected advertising budgets are approximately $1,000–$3,000 USD per client per month, paid separately from your management fee.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Review the client’s offer, audience, conversion destination, and account readiness before launch.

• Set up and manage
 and Instagram campaigns in Meta Ads Manager.

• Configure or verify conversion tracking, including Meta Pixel and Conversions API where appropriate; identify any implementation support needed.

• Develop targeting, retargeting, campaign structure, ad copy, and testing plans.

• Provide clear creative briefs and feedback to our content team.

• Monitor spending and optimize toward the agreed business objective.

• Distinguish inquiries from qualified leads, booked appointments, and sales when data is available.

• Provide a concise weekly update and monthly performance report covering spend, results, cost per result, tests, issues, and next steps.

• Flag tracking problems, weak offers, landing-page issues, or lead-follow-up gaps promptly.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



• Demonstrated experience independently managing Meta lead-generation campaigns.

• Relevant results for U.S. service businesses, coaches, consultants, or personal brands.

• Ability to work effectively with modest advertising budgets.

• Strong understanding of conversion tracking and campaign troubleshooting.

• Clear written English and reliable communication.

• Ability to explain your decisions and results in plain language.



This role requires an experienced campaign operator who can recommend and execute a plan without step-by-step technical supervision.



WORKING ARRANGEMENT



• Remote, freelance, with scope and payment agreed before work begins.

• Quote separately for initial setup and recurring monthly management per client account.

• Inner Views remains the primary client contact.

• Clients retain ownership of their advertising accounts and data.

• Video production, organic social posting, community management, and landing-page development are outside this role unless separately agreed.

• Please state your availability for scheduled calls overlapping with U.S. Central Time. A full overnight shift is not required.

• No unpaid custom campaign builds or live-account trials are requested. Any trial work will have an agreed paid scope.



HOW TO APPLY



Use “Meta Lead Gen — [Your Name]” as your application heading and include:



1. A brief summary of your relevant experience and the industries you know best.

2. One or two anonymized case studies showing the timeframe, ad spend, objective, results, and your specific responsibilities. Clearly distinguish leads, qualified leads, appointments, and sales.

3. Your monthly management rate in USD for one account spending $1,000–$3,000 monthly, plus any separate setup fee.

Pull the agent's real property footage in as B roll

Set up Meta Business Manager, Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager accounts, including pixels, conversion tracking and audience setup. Pause underperformers, scale winners, run A/B tests. Pull weekly performance data into our reporting template. Flag issues, disapprovals or anomalies to us the same day they happen. Three or more years running paid campaigns on Meta and Google at a minimum. LinkedIn Ads experience strongly preferred. Meta Blueprint or Google Ads certifications a plus. Strong written English and reliable daily communication on Slack. Able to work roughly four to six hours overlap with Irish business hours (GMT/IST).

What we provide

Written briefs for every campaign. All creative assets, copy direction and audience research. A reporting template. Clear onboarding and SOPs. Direct access to us on Slack during working hours.

The setup

Part-time to start, roughly 20 to 25 hours per week, with view to full-time within three to six months as the client base grows. Fully remote, long-term position. Paid monthly.

Trial

One-month paid trial on two to three accounts to see how we work together. If it lands, we move to a longer-term arrangement.

title: Short-Form UGC Video Editor – Long-Term Opportunity
description:
I’m a U.S.-based UGC creator looking for a reliable short-form video editor to work with long-term.



I create direct-response UGC ads for apparel, fitness, lifestyle, and other consumer brands. Most videos are approximately 15–45 seconds and are used for Instagram,
, TikTok, and paid advertising.



I’m currently producing a fairly high volume of content and want to find one editor who can learn my style and eventually handle most of my editing without needing detailed instructions for every video.



PAY:

Starting around $5-$7 USD per finished video.



Some projects will be very simple, while others may require more editing. I’m open to discussing different rates for more complicated projects or multiple variations of the same video.



I also plan to offer performance bonuses for exceptional videos as we build a long-term working relationship.



WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR:



• Experience editing short-form / UGC content

• Strong sense of pacing and attention retention

• Clean cuts and natural-looking edits

• Good use of on-screen text and captions

• Ability to use B-roll, overlays, music, and product footage when appropriate

• Ability to keep videos simple and native-looking when that is the better choice

• Good creative judgment

• Reliable turnaround

• Good communication in English

• Comfortable receiving and delivering files through Google Drive

• Willingness to learn my editing style over time



I do NOT want every video heavily edited with unnecessary effects, transitions, zooms, or captions. A lot of my best-performing ads are simple. The goal is to make the video better, not make the editing distracting.



--------------------------------------------------

APPLICATION TEST – PLEASE READ CAREFULLY

--------------------------------------------------



I am using a short editing assignment as the first part of the application process.



TEST FILES:





Inside the folder you will find:



• The raw footage

• The finished video that I edited myself



YOUR TASK:



Recreate my finished video using the raw footage provided.



I want the timing, pacing, cuts, text placement, music/style, and overall feel to be as close to my finished version as reasonably possible.



However, please CHANGE the visual style of the on-screen text slightly (font, styling, or another obvious text detail) so I can verify that you actually recreated the video yourself.



You do not have to use the exact same background music. Choose something similar that you think works well. 



Do not simply send my finished reference video back to me.



In the Google Drive folder you will also find several additional finished videos labeled “OTHER EXAMPLES OF MY STYLE.”



You do NOT need to recreate those videos.



They are only included so you can get a better understanding of the different types of UGC ads I create and my overall editing style.



For this first assignment, ONLY recreate the video located in the “VIDEO TO RECREATE” folder.



When you apply, please send me:



1. A link to your completed recreation

2. 2–3 examples of your best short-form or UGC edits

3. What editing software you use

4. Your normal rate for a 15–45 second short-form video

5. Approximately how many videos you could edit per week

6. Your typical turnaround time

7. A short answer explaining why you think you would be a good fit for this position



IMPORTANT:



Start your application with the words:



HEATH VIDEO EDITOR



If those words are not at the beginning of your application, I will assume the full job post was not read.



--------------------------------------------------

SECOND ROUND

--------------------------------------------------



I will select a small number of the strongest applicants for a second test.



For that test, I will provide raw footage and other materials for another ad, but I will NOT show you my finished version.



You will edit it based on what you learned about my style from the first assignment.



This second test is designed to find someone who can eventually understand my style and make good editing decisions without me directing every individual cut.



I’m looking for someone I can build a long-term working relationship with. There should be consistent ongoing work for the right person.

title: Growth Marketing Lead | Meta Ads + CRM + Funnel Optimization
description:
Growth Marketing Lead | Meta Ads + CRM + Funnel Optimization



We are looking for a senior, hands-on Growth Marketing Lead to help grow a local wellness business in Utah.

This is not primarily a social media, content, or basic media-buying role.

We are a location-based membership business with significant unused capacity, so profitable recurring membership growth is the primary objective.



Your responsibility is to help us improve the entire customer growth funnel:

Traffic → First Purchase → Visit → Second Visit → Membership → Retention → Referral



We already have:

- An operations lead

- An in-location manager

- A marketing/CRM execution team member

- Existing franchise marketing resources



You will own growth strategy and experimentation, including d
 what to test, prioritizing the work, directing our marketing execution resource, and measuring whether it is working.



Areas you may own

- Personally managing Meta campaigns, including campaign setup, audience strategy, budget allocation, optimization, creative testing, and performance analysis

- Customer segmentation and positioning

- Offers and landing pages

- Funnel/conversion optimization

- CAC, LTV and cohort analysis

- Tracking and attribution

-
/SMS lifecycle strategy

- First-visit and second-visit conversion

- Membership conversion

- Reactivation

- Retention and referrals

- Directing our existing marketing execution resource



This is a hands-on role. You will personally manage our paid media campaigns, especially during the initial 30–90 days, while directing other team members for CRM,
, SMS, reporting, and implementation support.  

We are looking for someone who can both execute where needed and operate at a higher level by diagnosing problems, prioritizing experiments, directing the team, and owning growth outcomes.



Initial engagement

We will begin with a paid 30-day trial. Your first objective will be to:

1. Understand our current funnel and customer economics.

2. Establish baseline metrics.

3. Identify the largest constraint to membership growth.

4. Prioritize and launch growth experiments.

5. Direct our existing team in execution.

6. Create a simple weekly growth scorecard.

7. Recommend the next 60–90 days.



If the fit is strong, this can become an ongoing and increasingly important role.

Expected capacity is approximately 20–25 hours per week.

Compensation is approximately $1,500–$2,500 USD/month depending on experience.



This is an outcome-oriented role rather than an hourly task-based position. We care more about ownership, judgment, experimentation, and measurable growth than hours logged.



To apply, please answer these questions

1. Give us 2–3 examples of growth initiatives you personally led.

For each include:

- The business/product

- The problem

- What you changed

- Actual results before and after

- What you personally owned

Include metrics such as CAC, conversion rate, revenue, ROAS, LTV, retention, or recurring revenue where possible.



2. Scenario

A local wellness business sells a first visit for $45.

Paid acquisition currently costs approximately $100–$130 per first-time purchaser. Most first-time customers do not return, membership conversion is low, and there is significant unused capacity.

You have an operations lead, an in-location manager, and a team member available to execute CRM/email/SMS work.

What would you investigate first, and what would your first 30 days look like?

Keep your response concise.



3. Include

- Current location/time zone

- Weekly availability

- Desired compensation

- Earliest start date



Please organize your application using the three sections above and keep it concise.

We value clear thinking and specific results over polished presentation.

title: Collections & Accounts Specialist
description:
We're looking for a Collections & Accounts Specialist to join an early-stage security technology startup as part of their offshore operations team.



This company uses technology to make it easier for businesses to access and manage security services. This role will focus on collections, client accounts, billing, and customer support, making sure accounts stay accurate, invoices are paid on time, and payment or account issues are followed up on and resolved quickly.



This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working with customers, following up on payments, solving problems, and keeping things moving. You'll communicate directly with clients and agencies, follow up on outstanding invoices, verify payments, answer account questions, and help make sure client accounts are accurate and up to date.



As part of an early-stage company, you'll have a lot of ownership in the role. You'll be trained on their systems and processes, but you'll also be expected to take initiative, work independently, make decisions, and take things and run with them.



What You'll Do

- Manage day-to-day collections, billing, and client account activities.

- Follow up with clients and agencies on outstanding invoices and overdue payments.

- Communicate directly with clients and agencies about invoices, payments, account questions, and discrepancies.

- Monitor accounts and payment status to identify overdue, missing, or incorrect payments.

- Review invoices and verify that billing amounts are accurate.

- Research and resolve payment discrepancies, billing issues, and account concerns.

- Provide customer support related to client accounts, invoices, payments, and billing questions.

- Keep accurate records of invoices, payments, collection follow-ups, account activity, and outstanding balances.

- Coordinate with internal teams to clarify billing, staffing, or account-related questions.

- Help maintain accurate client account information and follow up on anything that needs to be corrected or updated.

- Help improve collections, billing, and account management processes.

- Identify recurring customer or payment issues and suggest practical ways to improve processes.

- Take on different responsibilities as the company grows.



What We're Looking For

- 2+ years of experience in collections, accounts receivable, billing, account management, or a similar customer-facing role.

- Experience managing customer or client accounts, invoices, outstanding payments, and payment follow-ups.

- Direct experience working with U.S.-based customers or clients is highly preferred.

- Experience working with a staffing agency, recruitment agency, BPO, or other service-based agency is highly preferred.

- Strong customer support and communication skills, with experience communicating directly with clients about payments, account concerns, and billing issues.

- Experience reviewing invoices, verifying payment amounts, and resolving billing or payment discrepancies.

- Experience working with timesheets or timekeeping systems is a huge plus, especially in a staffing, BPO, or service-based environment.

- Previous experience working with a startup or fast-paced environment is a strong plus.

- Experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools to improve workflows or solve problems is a plus.

- Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills, with the ability to follow issues through to resolution.

- Able to work independently, take ownership, and make decisions without needing constant direction.

- Comfortable learning new systems and working with technology.

- Must be available to work U.S. time zones.

- Reliable internet connection and a dedicated WFH setup required.



Salary and Benefits

- Base salary: 65,000 PHP per month

- Paid Time Off + Paid Holidays

- 100% WFH



Application Instructions

Links from Dropbox, OneDrive, OnlineJobs, or other similar platforms, as well as non-direct file links, may not be reviewed by our Talent Team.

- Copy and paste this Job ID: reczsC6JVkMAhC0er and include it in your

title: Virtual Assistant – Lead Generation & Sales
description:
About Alkira Adina Equestrian



Alkira Adina Equestrian is an established equestrian education business based in Adelaide, South Australia.



I founded and run the business as a registered teacher and qualified horse riding instructor, combining education, experiential learning and horses to create meaningful learning experiences for children, young people and adults.



Alongside our physical Adelaide-based business, I am growing Alkira Adina Academy, our online education arm.



I have recently developed an Equine Assisted Learning (EAL) Facilitator Professional Development Program for people who want to develop their knowledge and skills in EAL and potentially incorporate it into their existing work or develop their own practice.



The program is self-paced and includes six personalised mentoring sessions, a Certificate of Completion and access to an ongoing private EAL Facilitator community for continued support and connection.



I’m now looking for a proactive VA to help me grow this side of the business. 



About the role



This is not a general admin or social media VA role.



I’m looking for someone interested in lead generation, relationship building and sales.



Your initial focus will be finding the right potential students, starting genuine conversations, following up with interested people and helping turn those conversations into enrolments.

* Research and identify potential students through
, Instagram, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms

* Find people who may be interested in EAL, education, coaching, facilitation, horses or related fields

* Start personalised conversations with potential students

* Respond to enquiries and follow up with warm leads

* Learn the program so you can confidently explain the basics

* Ask questions to understand whether the program is suitable for someone

* Help move interested prospects towards enrolment

* Keep simple records of leads and outcomes



This is NOT a mass-DM role



I am not looking for someone to send hundreds of generic messages.



I want someone who can identify the right people, start a genuine conversation and build trust.



Relationship first. Sales second.



You will work alongside an established marketing team member who manages our broader marketing activity, while your focus will be on lead generation, relationship building and sales conversations.



About you

* Lead generation

* Sales or appointment setting

* Social media outreach

* Customer service

* Online education, coaching or similar

* Excellent written English

* Strong communication skills

* Confidence starting conversations

* Good research and follow-up skills

* Initiative and the ability to work independently

* A willingness to learn and achieve results

Pay



$4 USD/hour + 10% commission on course sales

Commission is paid on completed course sales, not simply leads or enquiries.

title: Solar Project Manager – Remote
description:
Position: Solar Project Manager

Job Type: Temporary / Contract

Initial Duration: 3 Months

Potential for Full-Time: Yes, based on performance and company needs

Rate: $7–$9 USD per hour

Schedule: U.S. Business Hours

Location: Remote / Work From Home



We are a growing solar installation company looking for a reliable, organized, and proactive Solar Project Manager to help manage our solar projects from permit application through interconnection and PTO.



This is initially a 3-month temporary position, with the possibility of becoming a full-time, long-term position for the right person based on performance, reliability, and ability to manage projects independently.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of projects, stay on top of deadlines, follow up with cities and utilities, and make sure projects keep moving forward.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Permitting

Prepare and submit solar permit applications to the appropriate city/county/AHJ.

Track permit status and follow up with permitting departments.

Monitor plan check comments and correction notices.

Coordinate revisions and resubmissions.

Make sure permits are approved and ready for installation.



2. Project Tracking & Progress

Monitor projects from sales/contract handoff through completion.

Keep track of where every project stands and what needs to happen next.

Follow up with customers, contractors, vendors, cities, and utilities.

Identify stalled projects and take action to move them forward.

Maintain accurate project records, spreadsheets, and/or project management software.

Track important deadlines, documents, inspections, and approvals.

Make sure no project or task falls through the cracks.



3. Meter & Inspection Scheduling

Schedule required building/electrical/solar inspections.

Coordinate meter spot/site visits when required.

Coordinate inspection schedules with homeowners and field crews.

Track inspection results and arrange re-inspections when necessary.

Follow up until inspections are successfully completed.

Coordinate with utilities regarding meter installation or replacement.



4. Utility Interconnection

Prepare and submit utility interconnection applications.

Track applications from submission through approval.

Communicate with utilities regarding application requirements, corrections, and missing documents.

Follow up regularly on pending applications.

Coordinate utility meter work when applicable.

Track projects through Permission to Operate (PTO).



QUALIFICATIONS

Previous solar project management experience is strongly preferred.

Experience with California solar permitting and utility interconnection is highly preferred.

Familiarity with cities/counties, AHJs, inspections, and utility processes.

Excellent organizational and follow-up skills.

Strong written and spoken English.

Comfortable communicating professionally through email and phone.

Able to manage multiple projects at the same time.

Extremely detail-oriented.

Proactive and able to work independently.

Comfortable using spreadsheets, email, online permitting portals, and project management software.

Must have a reliable internet connection and be available during U.S. business hours.



THE TYPE OF PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We need someone who doesn't simply wait for instructions.



The ideal candidate should be able to look at a project and ask:



“Where is this project right now? What is holding it up? What needs to happen next? Who do I need to contact? And when should I follow up again?”



You will be responsible for keeping projects moving and making sure deadlines, applications, inspections, and utility requirements are followed up on.



You should be comfortable making phone calls, sending follow-up emails, checking application portals, coordinating schedules, and communicating with different parties to get projects completed.



COMPENSATION & EMPLOYMENT



$7–$9 USD per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.



This is initially a 3-month temporary position. However, there is an opportunity for the position to become full-time and long-term if you perform well, demonstrate reliability, and are a good fit for our company.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send us:



* Your resume or work history.

* A brief description of your previous solar project management experience.

* Which California utilities and permitting jurisdictions you have worked with.

* Your expected hourly rate ($7–$9/hour).



IMPORTANT: Please make sure all of the requested information is included in your application. Applications that do not provide the requested details will not be considered.

Torqify Ltd is a UK influencer marketing agency connecting automotive and lifestyle brands with content creators across the UK, US and Europe. We're growing fast and need a sharp, detail-oriented VA to build and run our lead generation and outreach, from finding the data through to booking brand calls.



What you'll be doing



Research and data (weeks 1–4)



Review our creators' content from the last 6 months (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok) and log every brand sponsoring them

Find the right decision-maker at each brand (influencer marketing, partnerships or marketing manager), with a verified
 and LinkedIn profile

Research new brands in automotive, car care, aftermarket parts, tech, energy drinks and lifestyle that are actively running creator campaigns

Find and vet new creators: average views, audience location, engagement and past sponsors



CRM management (ongoing)



Clean and maintain our CRM in Google Sheets: remove duplicates, fill gaps, fix formatting and keep every deal and contact up to date

Log all outreach, replies and follow-ups so nothing falls through the cracks

Send a weekly report: leads added,
s sent, replies, calls booked



Outreach (from month 2)



Load lead lists into our cold
 platform (Instantly) and manage campaigns

Handle first replies and follow-ups using our templates

Reach out to creators and talent agencies to request rates and media kits

Book qualified brand calls into our calendar



Longer term



Manage the full outreach pipeline end to end

Support campaign admin: contracts, briefs, content deadlines and invoice tracking

Potential to move into negotiation and account management



What we're looking for



Experience in lead generation, data research or influencer marketing (agency experience is a big plus)

Strong with Google Sheets, data entry and organisation

Confident finding contact details using LinkedIn, Apollo, Hunter or similar

Excellent written English

Reliable, proactive, and happy to work independently

Experience with Instantly, Apollo or other cold
 tools is a bonus



Test task (required)



Find 3 automotive brands that are currently actively sponsoring influencers on YouTube / Instagram, and collect the following data in a spreadsheet: Brand, POC,
, Role, Linkedin, Influencers recently sponsored (with link). Note generic sales@ or info@
s do not count



Applications without the test task will not be considered.



To apply



Start your application with the words "Torqify Pipeline" so we know you've read this listing. Include:



A short introduction and relevant experience

Your test task link (make sure sharing is set to "anyone with the link")

Your available hours in Philippines time

title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Technician
description:
Job Summary:



We are seeking a skilled Artificial Intelligence (AI) Technician to research and implement cutting-edge AI technologies across all facets of our business. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in AI/ML models, data processing, and automation. This role requires expertise in integrating AI-driven solutions to enhance operations, improve efficiency, and drive innovation.



Key Responsibilities:



Research and evaluate emerging AI technologies to identify opportunities for business-wide implementation.

Deploy AI models and automation tools to improve processes across different departments.

Integrate and optimize tools like Vic.ai for invoice automation, Dext for receipt management, Fathom or Jirav for cash flow forecasting, and 7shifts for labor optimization.

Ensure POS and accounting systems (e.g., Lavu and Restaurant365) are synced using tools like Zapier, Make, or Omnivore.

Implement and maintain internal AI dashboards using Power BI or Looker Studio for insights into financials, labor metrics, and operational performance.

Streamline bank transaction imports into Restaurant365.

Implement reconciliation tools like AutoRek or BlackLine and explore smart bookkeeping assistants such as Botkeeper or Zeni.

Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize AI systems for performance, accuracy, and scalability.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions into business operations, customer support, marketing, finance, and other applicable areas.

Ensure AI solutions align with industry standards, ethical guidelines, and business objectives.

Provide technical support, training, and documentation for AI applications across teams.

Stay updated with the latest AI trends, tools, and best practices to drive continuous innovation.









Required Skills & Qualifications:



Strong understanding of machine learning, natural language processing (NLP), and computer vision.

Experience with AI frameworks

Knowledge of AI ethics, bias mitigation, and responsible AI practices.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote environment.





Benefits:



Additional leave

Health insurance

Pay raise

Work from home

title: Marketing Specialist/ Digital Marketer/CMO/Marketing Manager
description:
We are the Graham Group, a top-producing real estate team with eXp Realty based in Birmingham, Alabama. Since 2012 we've built one of the most successful teams in our market — multiple-time eXp ICON Award winners, $40M+ in annual production, and trainers and coaches to 80+ agents nationwide.



We believe great real estate is about trust and systems: showing up like a professional from the first 
nt a consumer meets us, nurturing that relationship over time, and staying connected long after the sale. We're looking for a marketing leader who can build the engine that makes that happen at scale.





THE ROLE



This is not a "post on Instagram" job. You will own the entire marketing function for our team. You'll set the strategy, build the systems, generate leads, manage our content team, and tie every dollar we spend to a measurable result. You'll be the person who makes sure our brand looks elite, our pipeline stays full, and our database never goes cold.



If you're strategic and willing to roll up your sleeves, this is your seat.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN



Strategy & Brand

- Build and execute the team's overall marketing strategy and annual plan.

- Own our brand — voice, look, and consistency across every channel and touchpoint.

- Position the Graham Group as the trusted, go-to authority in our market.



Lead Generation

- Plan, launch, and optimize paid ad campaigns 
, Instagram, Google, YouTube).

- Drive a consistent flow of buyer and seller leads and track cost-per-lead and ROI.

- Develop landing pages, lead magnets, and conversion funnels.



Nurture & Trust Systems (core to who we are)

- Build automated and personal follow-up systems in our CRM that nurture leads from first contact to closing — and beyond.

- Create the "stay-in-touch" and post-close campaigns that turn past clients into repeat and referral business.

- Make every consumer feel like they're working with a true professional at every stage.



Content & Social

- Own the content calendar across YouTube, Instagram,
, TikTok, and email.

- Manage and direct the marketing editor and contractors to produce video, graphics, and listing content on schedule.

- Lead our YouTube and SEO strategy so we get found organically.



Listings & Agent Attraction

- Build a repeatable listing marketing system so every property gets a professional rollout.

- Support agent recruiting and attraction marketing for our growing team.



Analytics

- Track and report on every channel — leads, conversion, engagement, spend, and ROI.

- Use the data to double down on what works and cut what doesn't.





WHAT YOU BRING



- 3+ years of marketing experience with a track record of generating leads and measurable results (real estate or related industry strongly preferred).

- Both strategic thinking and hands-on execution — you can build the plan and do the work.

- Hands-on experience running paid ad campaigns (Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads).

- Experience with a CRM and building email/automation nurture campaigns (Follow Up Boss, kvCore, or similar a plus).

- Strong grasp of social media, content, and SEO.

- Comfort reading data and reporting on ROI.

- Excellent written communication and a sharp eye for brand and design.

- Self-starter who thrives with systems and ownership.





NICE TO HAVE



- Direct real estate marketing experience.

- Experience managing a small team or contractors.

- Video, design, or copywriting skills.

- Familiarity with marketing automation and AI tools.





WHY WORK WITH US



- A proven, successful, growing team that genuinely values marketing.

- Real ownership of a function — your work directly drives the business.

- Performance-based upside tied to the leads and ROI you create.

- A leadership team that lives and breathes systems, training, and growth.





HOW TO APPLY



1. Submit your resume and a short note on a marketing campaign you ran that produced real, measurable results — what you did, and the numbers.

2. Include links to work samples or a portfolio.

3. Start your message with the word "SYSTEMS" so we know you read the full posting.



We're looking for a sharp, accountable marketing leader who wants to build something great with us. We can't wait to meet you.

title: Streamer Outreach Reps
description:
Royale Arcade is hiring: Streamer Outreach Reps (Remote, Commission-Based)



We’re a studio making slot games and we don’t care about platform etiquette. We just want streamers playing our slots on stream. If you’re willing to ignore chat rules, spam, and push until they play, we want you.

What you’ll do



Hunt down any live streamer with an audience (Twitch, Kick, YouTube Live — doesn’t matter if they normally play slots or not).

Flood their chat, DMs, 
,
/X, whatever works. Keep messaging until they try our slots.

When they play, grab a clip of the session and submit it for your payout.

Track who you’ve hit so we can scale volume. No soft limits.



How you get paid



Payout for every streamer you get to play our slots on stream (verified by your clip). Based on live viewer count at the time they play:



Under 100 viewers: $5

100–999: $20

1,000–4,999: $60

5,000+: $150



One payout per streamer goes to the first valid clip submitted.

Minimum play requirement



Streamer has to play at least 10 minutes on stream. That’s it.

Clip requirements



Clearly shows them playing a Royale Arcade slot

Shows channel name + viewer count

Submitted within 24 hours with stream/VOD link



Outreach style we actually want



Do not identify as a Royale Arcade rep unless it helps.

Spam is fine. Multiple messages, different accounts, tag them, drop links, whatever gets them to load the game.

Ignore chat rules, slow-mode, bans, platform ToS. Just get the play.

Target anyone with eyes on their stream — gambling creators, variety streamers, just chatting, IRL, doesn’t matter. Adults preferred but volume comes first.

No “polite one message and leave.” Persistence is the job.



Who we’re looking for



Comfortable with Twitch/Kick/YouTube culture and not scared of getting timed out or banned.

Thick-skinned, pushy, and results-focused.

Organized enough to track outreach and clip fast.

18+ (or legal age wherever you are).

Experience with retargeting, lookalike audiences, and scaling campaigns

Highly analytical, detail-oriented, and proactive

CTR optimization

Conversion rate improvement

CPA efficiency

Scalable campaign performance

Accuracy of reporting and insights

Nice to Have

Experience in health & wellness or DTC e-commerce

Experience with email marketing and retention strategies

Familiarity with CRO and A/B testing tools



Schedule

Full-time (8 hours)

Graveyard shift (US hours) required



What We Offer

100% remote work

Training provided

Growth opportunities into leadership roles



How to Apply



Please submit:



Updated resume

A thoughtful, original cover letter



In your cover letter:



Naturally include the phrase “I love coffee”

Share something about yourself not found in your resume



Answer the following:

1. Describe your experience with paid advertising, especially TikTok Ads. What does your daily workflow look like when managing e-commerce campaigns? Include platforms used (Meta, Google, TikTok, etc.).

2. Do you have experience working with platform algorithms and ensuring ad compliance while optimizing performance? Briefly share an example.



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the next steps.

title: Accounting Supervisor
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW:

SimpleKeep is a modern US-based accounting company that values our team and creates a fun, dynamic work environment. Our goal is to provide exceptional accounting services to our clients while fostering a positive and supportive team culture. We are a remote team that leverages the latest technology to work together efficiently and effectively.



We're a great company to work for, and a small team, so you'll be able to come in and really have an impact on the way we do business. We're growing, and we’re looking to add an experienced person to our team.



POSITION OVERVIEW:

We’re seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Accounting Supervisor with proficiency in QuickBooks and Xero to join our growing remote team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in accounting, a passion for mentoring and developing staff, and a desire to work in a dynamic and supportive team environment. This is a remote position with flexible work hours.



RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Supervision and Leadership:

- Manage and oversee daily accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general ledger.

- Mentor and provide guidance to junior accountants and other team members.

- Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to staff.

- Develop and maintain accounting policies and procedures.

2. Financial Reporting:

- Oversee the preparation and analysis of financial statements.

- Ensure timely and accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.

- Provide financial analysis and insights to clients.

3. Bookkeeping and Reconciliation

- Ensure accurate and timely recording of financial transactions.

- Oversee bank reconciliations, accounts payable, and accounts receivable processes.

- Ensure accurate and timely month-end and year-end close processes.

- Prepare financial statements and other financial reports.

4. Budgeting and Forecasting:

- Lead the preparation of budgets and financial forecasts.

- Monitor budget performance and report variances.

5. Tax Compliance:

- Supervise the preparation and filing of tax returns.

- Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local tax regulations.

6. Software Utilization:

- Oversee the use of QuickBooks and Xero for all accounting functions.

- Ensure data integrity and accuracy within these systems.

7. Audit and Compliance:

- Ensure compliance with internal financial and accounting policies and procedures.

- Coordinate and support internal and external audits.

8. Communication:

- Communicate effectively with clients, vendors, and financial institutions.

- Provide clear and concise reports and updates to senior management.

- Ensure excellent English communication within the team and with stakeholders.

- Provide exceptional customer service to clients.

- Collaborate with other departments to streamline processes and improve efficiency.



QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

- CPA certification preferred.

- Minimum of 5 years of accounting experience, with at least 2 years in a supervisory role.

- Proficiency in QuickBooks and Xero is mandatory.

- Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting.

- Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

- Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Experience in managing remote teams and working with US clients.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other accounting software.

- Efficient, personable, adaptable, and organized.



WORK ENVIRONMENT:

This is a remote position; candidates must have a reliable internet connection and a dedicated workspace.



BENEFITS:

- Competitive salary and benefits package.

- Flexible work hours and remote work environment.

- Opportunities for growth and advancement.

- A supportive team culture that values work-life balance and employee satisfaction.

- Health card benefit after 9 months of employment.



WORKING SCHEDULE: Tuesday-Saturday 3am-12nn Manila Time

title: Marketing Director
description:
Job description:



Ashoori Law | Full-Time | Remote | Independent Contractor



Independent Contractor Notice



This is a full-time independent contractor position, not an employee position. The selected candidate will be responsible for their own taxes, registrations, and compliance obligations in their jurisdiction.



About Ashoori Law



Ashoori Law is a U.S.-based immigration law firm serving individuals, families, entrepreneurs, investors, and businesses with their U.S. immigration needs.



We are seeking an experienced Marketing Director to lead our marketing strategy, strengthen lead generation, improve conversion performance, and drive measurable business growth.



Position Overview



The Marketing Director will own the firm’s overall marketing strategy and performance. This role will oversee paid advertising, lead-generation funnels, HubSpot CRM and automation, website optimization, content strategy, analytics, and marketing attribution.



You will work directly with firm leadership and manage marketing agencies, contractors, media buyers, developers, designers, and content creators.



We are looking for a strategic leader who is also comfortable working hands-on with marketing data, systems, and execution.



Key ResponsibilitiesMarketing Strategy & Growth



Develop and execute the overall marketing and growth strategy

Establish marketing goals, KPIs, budgets, and performance targets

Identify opportunities to increase qualified leads, consultations, client acquisition, and revenue

Provide strategic recommendations and regular performance updates to leadership

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation



Oversee paid advertising across Google, Meta, YouTube, and other relevant platforms

Manage agencies, media buyers, and advertising vendors

Optimize advertising budgets, lead quality, cost per lead, and cost per booked consultation

Identify opportunities to scale high-performing acquisition channels

Funnel & Conversion Optimization



Own and improve the lead-to-consultation marketing funnel

Optimize landing pages, intake forms, follow-up systems, and consultation booking flows

Identify conversion bottlenecks and implement improvements

Develop testing strategies to improve conversion rates

HubSpot CRM & Automation



Oversee HubSpot CRM, marketing automation, and lead lifecycle management

Build and optimize
 sequences, workflows, and lead-nurturing systems

Improve lead follow-up and consultation booking rates

Ensure accurate lead tracking, attribution, and reporting

Website & Content



Oversee website performance, user experience, and conversion optimization

Coordinate improvements with developers, designers, SEO specialists, and other vendors

Lead content and digital marketing strategy

Ensure consistent, professional messaging across marketing channels

Team & Vendor Management



Lead and coordinate marketing agencies, contractors, vendors, and team members

Establish clear goals, deadlines, KPIs, and performance expectations

Evaluate performance and hold marketing partners accountable for results

Identify additional resources or capabilities needed to support growth

Reporting & Analytics



Track and report key marketing metrics, including:



Qualified leads and lead quality

Cost per lead and cost per booked consultation

Consultation booking and funnel conversion rates

Customer acquisition cost

Marketing-sourced revenue

Revenue attribution

ROAS and overall marketing ROI

Use performance data to recommend where marketing resources and budgets should be increased, reduced, or reallocated.



Required Qualifications



10+ years of progressive marketing experience, including senior-level marketing leadership

Proven experience developing and leading marketing strategies that generated measurable growth

Strong experience with paid advertising, lead generation, and conversion optimization

Advanced experience with HubSpot CRM and marketing automation

Strong understanding of marketing analytics, attribution, budgeting, and ROI

Experience managing marketing teams, agencies, contractors, and vendors

Ability to analyze performance data and translate it into actionable business decisions

Excellent communication, organization, and project management skills

Highly accountable, proactive, and results-oriented

Comfortable working directly with senior leadership in a remote environment

Preferred Qualifications



Previous experience as a Marketing Director, Head of Marketing, VP of Marketing, or similar senior marketing leader

Experience marketing legal or professional services

Experience with immigration law firm marketing

Experience working with U.S.-based businesses

Experience managing significant paid media budgets

Familiarity with compliance-sensitive industries

Performance-based bonuses may be offered based on measurable marketing results and growth.

title: AutoCAD Draftsman — German Architectural Floor Plans (metric / DIN standards), ongoing work
description:
We are a German drafting service and we are looking for an AutoCAD draftsman to produce architectural floor plans to German standards, on an ongoing basis.



This is not a one-off gig. We want to build a working relationship with one or two reliable people and send work their way continuously as our order volume grows.



What we do



We prepare CAD drawings for private clients, architects and planning offices in Germany. We handle the client, the site information and the full specification. You do the drawing.



A typical job: a client gives us a hand sketch, a survey, an existing plan or a set of measurements of a house. We turn that into a complete, dimensioned specification. You turn our specification into a clean DWG and a print-ready PDF that looks like it came out of a German architecture office.



Typical projects are detached houses, bungalows, apartments and small commercial units, usually 80 – 250 m², ground floor plans and occasionally upper floors. Scale 1:100 or 1:50, sheets DIN A3 or A2.



What the work involves

- Floor plans (Grundriss) — walls, openings, dimension chains, room stamps, furniture

- Occasionally as-built drawings from measured surveys

- Occasionally sections and elevations

- Always 2D. We do not need 3D modelling, rendering or visualisation.



Deliverables for every job:



- .dwg in AutoCAD 2018 format — drawn 1:1 in metres in model space, purged and audited, no xrefs, no proxy objects, nothing on layer 0, dimensions as real dimension objects and never exploded into lines and text

- .pdf — vector, true to scale, monochrome, with line weights plotted

- A short room schedule as a spreadsheet



What you need to be able to do



1. Work entirely in metric. Metres and centimetres. If your drafting experience is in feet and inches, this job is not for you — please do not apply.



2. Work to German drawing conventions. They differ from US and UK practice in specific ways. The most important ones:



- Dimension lines are terminated with a 45° oblique tick, never with an arrowhead

- The decimal separator is a comma: 3,99 — never 3.99

- Dimension text sits above the line, in metres with two decimals, readable from the bottom and from the right

- Dimension chains run in three parallel rows per façade, ordered from the building outwards: openings, then walls and rooms, then the overall dimension — and every chain has to close exactly

- Differentiated line weights: 0,50 mm for cut walls, 0,35 mm for visible edges, 0,25 mm for dimension lines, 0,13 – 0,18 mm for hatching. A drawing where every line has the same weight is not acceptable.

- 45° hatching on cut masonry, at a spacing that actually reads on the printed sheet

- A disciplined layer structure, everything set to ByLayer

- Text in a TrueType font so that German characters (ä ö ü ß) render correctly



You do not need to know these conventions by heart. We supply a written brief of about 6.000 words in English that specifies every one of them: layer names, line weights, text heights, dimension style settings, hatch patterns, title block content and a final self-check list. But you need to be the kind of drafter who can follow a specification to the millimetre. That is the core of this job.



3. Draw clean geometry. Closed polylines, no gaps at wall junctions, no duplicate lines, no overshoots. We check this.



4. Communicate in written English. You do not need to speak German. All German text that appears on the drawing — room names, notes, title block — is supplied as ready-to-copy strings.



What you get from us



We do not send vague requests. Before you start a job you receive:



1. The full written brief with every drawing convention specified

2. A dimensionally verified schematic from us — every dimension chain already closed, with a door schedule and a window schedule giving the exact position of every opening from a defined origin point, and the furniture layout with sizes

3. All site information



There are no design decisions for you to make and nothing to guess. If something in our package is ambiguous, you ask and we answer — that is on us, not on you.



How we start



The first assignment is a small paid test task of about two hours — one band of rooms with walls, openings, one dimension chain and one room stamp. Paid at your normal rate. It tells both of us within a day whether the conventions work out, before either side commits to a full project.



After that, the first full project is roughly 15 hours of work.



On volume, honestly: we are a young business and growing. We are not going to promise you a guaranteed number of hours every week, because we cannot. What we can say is that we intend to send every suitable job to the same person, and that we pay on time, every time.



Please do NOT apply if

- You work primarily in feet and inches

- Your portfolio is renderings, 3D models and visualisations rather than dimensioned working drawings

- You cannot show work you have drawn yourself

- You need a guaranteed full-time workload right now



A straight "this is not my kind of work" costs you nothing and we will remember you positively.



HOW TO APPLY — please read, this d
 it



1. Start your message with the word MASSKETTE. It is German for "dimension chain". It tells us you read the post rather than mass-applying. Applications without it are not read.



2. Attach one or two PDFs of dimensioned floor plans you have drawn yourself. Not renderings. Not 3D views. Working drawings with dimension chains, room labels and a title block. This is by far the most important part of your application — it tells us more than any description.



We will look at exactly these things in your sample:



- Do the dimension chains close, and are they complete?

- Are the line weights differentiated, or is everything one weight?

- Is the drawing in metric?

- Is the layer structure clean?

- Does the sheet look finished — title block, legend, north arrow, room stamps?



3. Answer these four questions, briefly:



a) Which countries' standards have you drawn to? If you have worked on German, Austrian, Swiss or other European projects, say so and say which office or client — that moves you to the front of the queue.



b) What is your hourly rate for this work, and roughly how many hours would you estimate for a furnished 150 m² single-storey floor plan at 1:100 on A3?



c) What does your capacity look like right now — how many hours per day, and which days?



d) Which CAD software do you own and use? (AutoCAD, BricsCAD, Revit, ArchiCAD — tell us the actual version.)



4. If you have a current project running and could start within the next few days, say so. We have work waiting right now.



Thank you for reading this far. We know it is a long post — that is deliberate. We would rather have five applications from people who fit than fifty from people who do not.



Sander Marquardt Zeichenpartner, Germany

title: Sales Closers (Hourly Base + High Commission) Hot Leads
description:
We are looking for multiple salespeople who consider themselves closers and are looking for a high commission earning opportunity. Just to be clear, we will pay an hourly base of $5/hour. That way you know we're not a company that wants you to work for free and go through unpaid sales training. We will absolutely pay for you to go through sales training, but if you don't pick up the material as quickly as your peers in the initial cohort, we will be quick to ask you to leave.



So to be absolutely clear, we are a company that is very sales oriented, offers daily sales training, pays a $5/hour base, and pays for you to go through training. However, we are looking for someone who is looking to make well beyond $40 per day.



If you have a burning desire to make a lot of money -- double, triple, quadruple, even 10 times what your peers make, then we have an opportunity for you. 



We are a notary and apostille service provider (aka document preparation). You don't have to know our industry at all. You just have to be good at sales and have a track record of selling in previous jobs, whatever the industry.



Once again, we are looking for people who want to make well beyond $5/hr. The true earning opportunity of this position lies in the commission.



Our average ticket value is about $1000. At a 5% starting commission on revenue (much better than on profit,) your average sale will earn you a $50 commission. With daily training on both industry knowledge, as well as more importantly hard sales techniques and script practice, we fully expect everyone in the cohort to be selling 3 sales per day before the year ends. We draw from the Jordan Belfort (Wolf of Wall Street) Straight Line Sales Persuasion system along with other materials in the training.



3 sales a day at $50 average commission would translate to about $150 USD worth of commissions daily, which far outweighs the $40 per day base. For salespeople who excel within the cohort and demonstrate themselves to be consistent closers, there will be a pathway to 10% commission which translates to about $100 per sale. At the same 3 sales a day, that would translate to an extra $300 per day USD on top of the $40 per day commission.



As you can see, the true opportunity lies in the sales commission. The base hourly is mostly there to help during the first few weeks as you get through training. We will hire several salespeople at once so you guys can all go through the training together. And of course if you claim to be a great salesperson, but it becomes clear that you're not, you will be asked to leave while top performers in the cohort continue on. 



The clients are fairly easy to sell as they come highly filtered and are hot leads through Google Ads. This position requires no cold calling. But because we spend a lot of money on Google Ads, we need sales closers who are enthusiastic, sharp, and quick to learn. If you cannot start closing sales after 3- 4 weeks, we will ask you to leave. The more experienced salespeople that have a learner's mindset and apply the sales training, should start selling within 1-2 weeks. The more you sell, the more we'll put ad spend behind you so that you have more leads until you feel you have too many leads to handle.



Any good salesperson tries to maximize their earning potential by maximizing their commission. The smartest and the most skilled salespeople would rather ask for a raise in commission than a raise an hourly. If you are applying for the job, because you're going to be satisfied with the $5/hr hourly, please do not apply. If you are applying for the job, because you want to make hundreds of dollars a day USD in commissions, please apply. Salespeople must have the burning desire to make a lot of money.



That said, we are an honorable company that offers a premium service with better customer service, faster turnaround times, and more solutions to our clients compared to our competition. We are sales oriented, and numbers focused, but we back it up with an incredible service experience on the backend that clients rave about. Knowing that we are serving our clients at the highest level amongst competitors gives us the confidence to tell potential clients to choose us.



Requirements:



1. Vocaroo Recording - Before offering you an interview, we need to hear a voice sample. Please send us a Vocaroo link with a short recording where you introduce yourself so we can see how you would sound on the phone. Part of this is seeing if you read the whole post and can follow instructions, so if you
 us a voice recording or send it via another platform, we simply won't listen to it. Put the Vocaroo recording link in your initial message to us when you apply to this position.



2. Resume - Provide your standard resume that includes your work experience



3. Your Why(s) - In your initial message to us, tell us a little bit about what motivates you and why you want to earn a lot of money through sales. Whether it's a personal dream or a desire to help someone else important to you, we want to know what makes you tick and what lights the fire within you to want to close sales, put up big numbers, and be a high earner.



We are looking to come to a decision over the weekend before the week begins, as we're very busy Monday through Friday (US). So submit your applications immediately and expect a quick response for an interview in the case that we like your voice recording, resume, and initial message. Looking forward to meeting the most promising applicants on zoom interviews over the next 48 hours, good luck and we'll be in touch!

title: Senior Meta Ads Media Buyer - Lead Gen for Home Remodeling Clients
description:
ABOUT US

BuildSignals is a US performance marketing agency. We get booked estimates for shower and bathroom remodeling companies using Meta 
/Instagram) lead-gen ads. Clients pay us for appointments that show up, so lead QUALITY and BOOKING RATES matter as much as cost per lead.



We're growing fast and need a senior media buyer to fully own our client ad accounts. The founder should be able to stop checking Ads Manager because you've got it handled.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Daily account management across all client accounts: launch, optimize, pause losers, scale winners, catch problems before clients notice

- Launching new clients using our proven campaign structure (ABO, Instant Form lead campaigns, multiple copy variations per ad)

- Diagnosing problems: when cost per lead or booking rate gets worse, figure out why (creative fatigue, audience, form, offer, market, follow-up) and fix it

- Creative testing: plan tests, brief new ad angles and write ad copy (primary texts and headlines)

- Client scorecard: track every client weekly from cost per lead to booking rate, show rate and jobs closed. Spot which clients are winning, which are at risk, and why

- Daily end-of-day update to the founder: account status, what changed, any issues and what you're doing about them



YOU MUST HAVE

- 2+ years hands-on in Meta Ads Manager, specifically lead-gen campaigns with Instant Forms

- Experience managing multiple client accounts at once for an agency

- Real results you can show: spend managed, CPLs achieved, and what you did to improve them

- Strong analytical skills. You look past the lead count to whether the leads turned into appointments

- Strong written English and a habit of reporting proactively

- Reliable internet, a backup power plan and a quiet workspace



NICE TO HAVE

- GoHighLevel experience

- Home services or remodeling clients (roofing, HVAC, bath, kitchen, etc.)

- US agency experience

- Basic Canva or creative skills



HOURS & PAY

- Full-time, 40 hours/week, with at least 4 hours overlapping US business hours

- $1,500 - $2,200/month depending on experience, plus a monthly performance bonus



HOW TO APPLY (takes about 5 minutes)

1. Start your message with the phrase: "Booked, not just leads."

2. In a few sentences, tell us about the biggest Meta lead-gen account you've managed: the niche, the monthly ad spend, and one result you're proud of (with real numbers).

3. Your expected monthly salary and available working hours (PH time).



Optional: a short Loom video (1-3 minutes) walking through an ad account you've managed. Applications with a Loom get reviewed first.



OUR HIRING PROCESS

Application review > 30-minute video call > paid test task (diagnose a real anonymized account) > 30-day paid trial > full-time role



This is a long-term role with room to grow into leading our ads team as we scale.

title: Event Operations Assistant
description:
About Us

We are a growing, US-based wedding and event photography and videography studio

dedicated to capturing once-in-a-lifetime celebrations. We pride ourselves on delivering

a five-star, high-touch experience to our couples, maintaining clear standards for our

creative subcontractors, and building an organized, supportive behind-the-scenes

culture.



The Opportunity: What We Are Looking For

We are searching for a sharp, proactive, and detail-oriented Event Operations Assistant

to serve as the operational backbone of our studio.

This is not a traditional data-entry virtual assistant role. We need a reliable partner with

a background in photography or video production who understands camera media, is

comfortable curating and editing sneak peeks in Lightroom, and can confidently

navigate event day logistics (there is no expectation to edit full galleries, we have an

editing team already established).

In this role, you will be the bridge between our couples, our on-site shooters, and our

editing team. You will oversee timelines in Sprout Studio, audit incoming raw files before

contractor payments are approved, keep clients excited and informed via warm SMS

and
 communication, and act decisively when unexpected schedule conflicts or

emergency cancellations arise.



Event Operations Assistant: Core Responsibilities

1. CRM & Event Coordination (Sprout Studio)

• Subcontractor Assignment: Assign confirmed lead photographers, second

shooters, and videographers to upcoming bookings within Sprout Studio.

• Editing Pipeline & Gallery Assignment: Assign event galleries and raw asset

batches to external editors based on project type, editor bandwidth, and agreed

turnaround deadlines.

• Timeline & Details Maintenance: Ensure all event profiles contain up-to-date

timelines, venue addresses, contact info, and custom client shot lists before the

shoot date.

• Milestone Tracking: Monitor scheduled events week-over-week to verify that all

preparation, shooting, editing, and delivery milestones remain on schedule.



2. Media Intake & Asset Auditing (Pre-Payment Verification)

• Contractual File Audits: Inspect raw file uploads from shooters to confirm every

contracted deliverable is present (e.g., verifying Camera A, Camera B, drone

footage, and external lapel/soundboard .wav audio files).

• Technical Completeness Checks: Confirm file counts, verify that raw files are

readable and uncorrupted, and ensure standard card-dump folder conventions

were followed.

• Payment Clearance Flagging: Mark projects as "Assets Verified" in the CRM so

management knows the subcontractor's invoice is cleared for payment release

(without scheduling or releasing funds directly).

• Missing Asset Follow-Up: Promptly reach out to photographers and

videographers if assets are missing, links are broken, or uploads are incomplete.



3. Editor Asset Management & Cold Storage Archival

• Final Deliverable Receipt: Confirm that editors have uploaded all completed

project assets (e.g., final high-res photo galleries, highlight films, project files).

• Cold Storage Migration: Transfer and organize all raw media and final edited

assets into long-term cold storage (e.g., AWS, Dropbox, Google Drive) using

standardized naming conventions and folder structures.

• Archive Maintenance: Keep storage drives indexed and organized so historical

projects can be retrieved immediately if a client requests re-delivery or album

design assets later.



4. Emergency Subcontractor Dispatch

• On-Call Issue Response: Handle sudden, last-minute cancellations, illnesses,

or travel emergencies from shooters leading up to or during event days.

• Backup Roster Activation: Rapidly broadcast availability requests to the pre-

vetted emergency network of photographers and videographers to lock in

replacement coverage.

• Logistical Handoff: Transfer shoot details, timelines, gear expectations, and

Sprout Studio assignments to the replacement shooter and notify management

once coverage is secured.



5. Client Communications 
 & SMS)

• Inquiry Management: Monitor and respond to client questions via
 and text

message during active shift hours.

• Timeline & Status Updates: Provide clients with warm, reassuring updates on

where their project sits in the editing pipeline and when to expect their final

galleries or films.

• Information Intake: Collect missing questionnaire details, updated wedding day

timelines, or special requests from clients and log them into Sprout Studio.



6. Sneak Peek Gallery Management & Production

• Photographer Submission Auditing: Check post-wedding uploads to verify

whether the lead photographer opted into the sneak peek bonus and submitted

their own edited previews.

• Backup Culling & Editing: If the photographer opts out or fails to submit edits,

review the raw intake files, select 10 to 20 key highlight frames (portraits, core

ceremony moments, reception details), and edit them using studio presets and

basic adjustments (exposure, white balance, framing).

• Gallery Creation & Upload: Create, upload, and format the 10 to 20 image

sneak peek gallery inside Sprout Studio or client proofing software.

• Early Delivery Handoff: Send the sneak peek gallery link to the client via

and SMS within the studio's designated turnaround window (e.g., 24 to 72 hours

post-event).



7. Seasonal Studio Projects & Systems Optimization (Off-Peak Focus)

During slower event months (typically late fall through winter), daily operational volume

naturally decreases. During these periods, focus transitions to studio improvement,

marketing operations, and administrative preparation for the upcoming season,

including:

• Subcontractor Recruitment Support: Assisting with seasonal hiring campaigns

by reviewing incoming photographer/videographer portfolios against studio

standards, logging candidate details, and sending onboarding agreements.

• Marketing & Social Coordination: Scheduling pre-approved social media

content, setting up publishing automations, and updating blog features with

recent event imagery to support organic search visibility.

• CRM & Workflow Optimization: Auditing and refining Sprout Studio templates,

canned
s, questionnaire workflows, and vendor directories.

• Digital Storage & File Maintenance: Conducting routine audits of active cloud

storage drives, organizing folder structures, and archiving completed assets.

• Administrative Project Support: Assisting with vendor document tracking,

timeline audits, and general operational tasks as directed by studio leadership.



Qualifications & Requirements

Must-Haves (Core Requirements)

• US Eastern Shift Alignment: Proven ability to work full-time graveyard hours

(typically 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM PHT / 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST), Monday through

Friday.

• Photography / Videography Literacy: Practical familiarity with photography or

video production workflows—you know how camera card dumps work,

understand RAW vs. JPEG files, and recognize standard video/audio formats

(.MOV, .MP4, .WAV).

• Basic Photo Culling & Editing Skills: Hands-on experience using Lightroom

(or comparable editing software) to cull raw images, apply presets, and make

basic adjustments (exposure, white balance, crop) for 10–20 photo sneak peeks.

• Meticulous Digital Asset Management: High attention to detail when

organizing large file libraries; disciplined with standardized folder structures and

cloud storage systems (Dropbox, Google Drive, or AWS).

• Excellent Written English: Strong written communication skills with the ability to

text and
 US wedding clients and creative contractors warmly, clearly, and

professionally.

• Calm Problem-Solving: Ability to think on your feet and act decisively when

unexpected schedule conflicts or emergency shooter cancellations arise.

• Reliable Remote Workstation: A dependable computer capable of handling

image batch previews/edits, a primary high-speed fiber internet connection, and

a secondary backup connection or power solution (UPS/hotspot) for shift

continuity.



Nice-to-Haves

• Prior experience using Sprout Studio or similar creative studio CRMs

(HoneyBook, Dubsado, Studio Ninja).

• Background in a US-facing BPO role, creative agency, or wedding

photography/videography studio.

• Basic understanding of professional wedding camera gear (e.g., dual card slots,

full-frame bodies, external audio lapels).



Compensation & Schedule

• Monthly Flat Retainer: $850 – $1,000 USD / month based on direct experience

with studio operations and photo editing.

• Payment Terms: Paid on the 1st and 15th of the month in USD, covering all

transfer processing fees so you receive your full earnings.

• 13th-Month Pay: Eligible for an annual 13th-month bonus.

• Work Arrangement: 100% remote, full-time position (40 hours per week, year-

round).

• Working Hours: Monday through Friday, US Eastern business hours (typically

9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST / 9:00 PM – 5:00 AM PHT). Shifts remain steady year-

round, with daily duties shifting between live event management during peak

season and studio improvement projects during off-peak season.
